title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT, CLIENT COORDINATOR AND SOCIAL MEDIA SUPPORT
description:
Part time remote role



Approximately 10 hours per week to begin, with the opportunity for additional hours as the role grows.



Pay: USD $6 to $8 per hour depending on experience.



I am a busy Sydney based marriage celebrant and MC looking for an organised, warm, proactive and creative Virtual Assistant to help me manage the administration, client experience and marketing side of my wedding business, Married by Jade.



My business is very personal and client focused, so I am looking for someone who is not only incredibly organised but also understands how important communication, customer experience, branding and social media are.



I want someone who can eventually become a real part of the business and help me grow Married by Jade, not just complete a list of admin tasks.



You need to be confident working independently, have excellent written English, be creative and be someone who notices what needs to be done without always needing to be asked.



THE ROLE



Your responsibilities will gradually include:



Managing and organising my business email inbox



Drafting replies to wedding enquiries and existing couples



Following up potential clients who have enquired but have not booked



Managing appointments and meetings in my calendar



Sending meeting reminders



Updating client information and workflows in Studio Ninja - I actually havent even fully set upo stuido ninja because i can't even cope working it out 



Sending questionnaires, information and reminders to couples



Following up outstanding invoices and payments



Basic Xero administration



Keeping Dropbox folders and client files organised



Preparing weekly lists of upcoming weddings, meetings, payments and tasks



Helping organise wedding reception run sheets and client information



Researching venues, accommodation and travel when required



General business administration



SOCIAL MEDIA AND MARKETING



A big part of this role will eventually be helping me grow Married by Jade through social media and marketing.



This may include:



Coming up with ideas for Instagram posts, Reels and Stories



Creating engaging social media content that suits my brand



Writing captions in my tone of voice



Turning wedding photos and videos into content



Creating educational wedding content for couples



Planning and scheduling social media posts



Helping create a consistent content calendar



Looking at trends and coming up with ways we can use them without losing the personality of my brand



Repurposing existing wedding content into new posts



Helping promote my celebrant and MC services



Creating content around wedding tips, ceremony ideas and behind the scenes moments



Helping increase enquiries through Instagram and other social platforms



Researching marketing ideas and opportunities



Looking at what content performs well and suggesting what we should do more of



Helping develop new ideas to grow the business and reach more couples



I am not looking for someone who simply posts content because it is on a schedule.



I want someone who can learn my brand, understand my personality and actively think about how we can use social media and marketing to grow the business.



ABOUT YOU



You are extremely organised and love keeping things in order.



You have excellent written and spoken English.



You communicate warmly and professionally.



You are confident using technology and learning new programs.



You are comfortable managing email, calendars, Google Drive and Dropbox.



Experience with Xero, Studio Ninja or another CRM is helpful but not essential.



You can follow systems but also use common sense.



You are proactive and do not need constant supervision.



You understand that wedding clients are often excited, emotional and sometimes stressed, so communication needs to feel personal and caring.



You are reliable and consistent.



You have excellent attention to detail.



You have a good eye for social media and understand what makes content engaging.



You are creative and enjoy coming up with new ideas.



You understand Instagram, Reels, Stories and social media trends.



Experience with Canva and social media scheduling platforms would be a big advantage.



You are interested in marketing and business growth.



Most importantly, I want someone who wants to become part of the business long term.



ABOUT ME



I am a Sydney based marriage celebrant and MC and run a busy wedding business called Married by Jade.



My style is modern, warm, fun and personal.



I work closely with my couples from the time they enquire through to their wedding day, so I want someone who will care about their experience as much as I do.



I also want to continue growing the business, building my social media presence and reaching more couples, so there is plenty of opportunity for this role to grow.



This role will begin with around 10 hours per week, but there is definitely room for additional hours once you understand the business and we build trust.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send me:



A short introduction about yourself



Your previous Virtual Assistant or administration experience



The programs and systems you have experience using



Your experience with Instagram, social media, Canva, content creation or marketing



Examples of social media accounts or content you have previously worked on if available



Your normal working hours and availability



Your hourly rate



Why you think you would be a good fit for a wedding business



Please also complete the two short tasks below.



APPLICATION TASK 1



Imagine a couple has sent this enquiry:



“Hi Jade, we are getting married next year and found you on Instagram. We love your vibe and wanted to know if you are available and how much you charge.”



Write the reply you would send on behalf of Married by Jade.



I am not looking for the longest answer.



I am looking for warmth, personality, excellent English and attention to detail.



APPLICATION TASK 2



Create one Instagram post for Married by Jade.



The post can be about weddings, choosing a celebrant, wedding planning, ceremony advice or something you think would suit my brand.



Please include:



The caption



The idea for the photo, carousel or Reel



The text you would put on the graphic or Reel cover if needed



A simple call to action



Please also briefly explain why you think this post would help grow the business or attract potential couples.



My brand is modern, warm, fun, personal and not overly cheesy.



For both tasks, I am looking at your creativity, written English, attention to detail, marketing ideas and whether you can understand the personality of the business.



Please do not overthink it. I want to see how you naturally communicate and what ideas you come up with.

title: Long-Term Part-Time Virtual Assistant
description:
We are seeking a dependable, long-term Virtual Assistant to become part of our team. This is NOT a short-term position. We are looking for someone who wants consistent, ongoing part-time work for years to come.



The position will begin on a full-time basis as I will need to train you, but once you learn how to complete tasks quickly and efficiently, it will transition into a part-time role. Of course, if you wish to continue learning and developing and taking on additional responsibilities with us, that is absolutely welcome and I can work with you to provide you with more work.



I need someone who is genuinely switched on and can learn quickly, as there are many nuances to understand across the different brands we manage.



I need someone who is not afraid to ask questions or to ask for help when needed. I am always available and more than happy to assist. I will never punish you or hold it against you for asking questions or for seeking help. I would much rather help you do the job correctly the first time than have you redo the same work repeatedly because it was done incorrectly and you were too afraid to ask for support.



What You'll Be Doing:

This position is heavily focused on data entry and requires someone who is completely comfortable with mundane, repetitive work, reviewing data, photos, and numbers for extended periods.



1) Product Uploads (Main Task): Reviewing product images and entering the corresponding data/tags into Excel using a pre-established format. Attention to detail is critical. For example, if you are tagging a product that appears as a red apple, the exact tag must be "Red". All formats and rules will be explained.



2) Monthly Promotions Update: Assisting with updating monthly promotions, options, products, and banners. This takes place at the end of each month.



3) Brand Uploads: Uploading new brands, which follows a similar process to product uploads.



4) Stock Updates: Updating stock quantities for specific products. This is mainly once per month but may be more frequent for certain brands.



Training will be provided. There is a lot to take in at the beginning, but once you understand how everything works, it is a very straightforward, repeatable process. I am always here to help clarify anything.



Requirements:

- Proficient in Microsoft Excel or alternatives that are compatible with .xlsx and .csv files – REQUIRED

- Good English and good communication skills - REQUIRED

- Extremely detail-oriented and accurate with data entry

- Comfortable with repetitive / mundane tasks for long periods

- Able to work quickly and efficiently without sacrificing accuracy

- Can understand basic maths, such as percentages

- Can understand simple logic such as how many pairs of any two things can be made

- Reliable, honest, and looking for long-term work

- Happy to start work right away and ready to learn



Schedule & Workload:

- This is a part-time role (but will start as full time as I will need to train you).

- Regular weeks: Monday to Wednesday

- End of month: You will be needed for the last few days of the month and first few days of the month to update monthly promotions and stock levels.



Compensation:

$100 / week for standard weeks (up to 3 days)

$150 / week for busier weeks (4 to 5 days)

Paid weekly. Opportunity for more hours/pay as we grow.



How to Apply:

To be considered, please start your application with the words "SWITCHED ON" so I know you read the whole post.



Please include:

- A short intro about yourself

- Your experience with Excel / data entry

- Your availability to start

- Applications without "SWITCHED ON" will not be considered.



I look forward to working with you!

title: Bilingual Credit Repair Specialist
description:
Credit Repair Virtual Assistant — U.S. Credit Repair Experience Required



I’m looking for an experienced, reliable Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines who has previous experience working with U.S. credit repair clients.



This position will initially be part-time, approximately 10–20 hours per week, with the possibility of increasing hours as the client pipeline grows.



Responsibilities



Review client credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

Identify collections, charge-offs, late payments, hard inquiries, bankruptcies, student loans, and other negative or potentially inaccurate reporting

Review differences in how accounts are reported across the three credit bureaus

Prepare and track disputes according to established procedures

Update client files and CRM records

Track dispute rounds and bureau responses

Organize client documents

Follow up with clients regarding missing documents and status updates

Maintain a clear calendar for 30-day follow-ups and credit reviews

Prepare weekly client progress reports

Help identify when a client may be ready to return to their mortgage lender for re-evaluation

Communicate with clients in both English and Spanish when needed

Maintain complete confidentiality of all client information



Required Experience



You must have previous experience working in the U.S. credit repair industry.



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



Credit Repair Cloud

DisputeFox

DisputeBee

GoHighLevel or other CRM systems

IdentityIQ

SmartCredit

MyScoreIQ

Other three-bureau credit-monitoring platforms



You should have working knowledge of:



FCRA

FDCPA

Metro 2 reporting basics

Credit bureau disputes

Collections

Charge-offs

Late payments

Hard inquiries

Credit utilization

Bankruptcy reporting, including Chapter 7 and Chapter 13

Student loan reporting

Federal and private student loans

Student loan late payments, collections, defaults, and reporting discrepancies

Mortgage-readiness credit review



Language Requirement



The ideal candidate must be able to communicate professionally in both:



English

Spanish



You should be comfortable speaking and writing with clients in both languages.



Important



I am NOT looking for someone who simply sends generic dispute letters.



I want someone organized, ethical, detail-oriented, and comfortable following an established credit-repair process.



You must not promise clients guaranteed deletions, guaranteed credit-score increases, or specific results.



Bankruptcies, student loans, collections, charge-offs, and other accounts should be carefully reviewed before any action is taken.



Any unusual, complicated, or questionable account should be escalated for review rather than disputed automatically.



Ideal Candidate



Previous U.S. credit repair experience

Fluent or highly proficient in English

Fluent or highly proficient in Spanish

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Detail-oriented and organized

Comfortable communicating with U.S. clients

Experience reviewing three-bureau credit reports

Experience with bankruptcies and student loan accounts

Experience with mortgage-readiness clients strongly preferred

Reliable internet connection

Able to work independently

Available for some overlap with U.S. Central Time

Real estate, mortgage, or lending-industry experience is a strong plus



Starting Pay



$5–$8 USD per hour depending on experience.



Approximately 10–20 hours per week to start.



There is opportunity for additional hours as the business grows.

description:
Remote | Full-Time | DTC / E-commerce



About Moon Nude



Moon Nude is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand creating thoughtfully designed quilted bags and accessories for women worldwide. We sell through our online store, Amazon, and TikTok Shop.



We’re a small, founder-led, fully remote team looking for a hands-on, performance-driven Creator & Influencer Marketing Manager to own our creator and influencer program from end to end.



This is not purely a relationship-management role. You’ll source creators, manage partnerships, oversee content production, run our creator community, and analyze performance to determine what we should improve, repeat, and scale.



Key Responsibilities

Source, assess, negotiate with, and manage creators and influencers.

Manage paid partnerships, product gifting, seeding, affiliate relationships, and ambassador programs.

Build a reliable pipeline of creators producing high-quality, on-brand content.

Negotiate rates, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, and partnership terms.

Create clear and actionable creator briefs.

Review creator content and provide detailed feedback on hooks, messaging, storytelling, product presentation, and conversion potential.

Manage Trybe, our owned creator community, including recruitment, onboarding, communications, feedback sessions, and creator engagement.

Recruit and manage TikTok Shop creators and affiliates.

Coordinate samples, commissions, content deadlines, contracts, approvals, payments, and follow-ups.

Identify and manage brand partnerships, giveaways, collaborations, and joint campaigns.

Maintain organized trackers for creators, content, costs, deliverables, and performance.

Analyze metrics including views, engagement, clicks, conversions, sales, CPA, ROI, and content efficiency.

Identify top-performing creators, hooks, concepts, formats, and messages.

Translate performance insights into better briefs and creator feedback.

Provide regular reports, insights, and recommendations to the founders.

Coordinate creator output with launches, paid advertising, and wider business priorities.

What We’re Looking For

Previous experience managing creator, influencer, affiliate, or ambassador programs.

Hands-on experience managing campaigns from creator sourcing through execution, reporting, and optimization.

Strong understanding of social media trends, influencer culture, and creator-led content that converts.

Confidence negotiating rates, usage rights, deliverables, and timelines.

Strong analytical skills and experience using performance data to make decisions.

Excellent organization and project-management skills.

Strong written and spoken English.

Personable, proactive, persistent, and comfortable holding creators accountable.

Willingness to review content closely, update trackers, follow up on late deliverables, and solve operational issues.

Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, founder-led environment.

Nice to Have

Experience in fashion, accessories, beauty, lifestyle, or another visually driven DTC or e-commerce category.

Experience managing TikTok Shop creators or affiliates.

Familiarity with creator content used in Meta or other paid social advertising.

Experience building or managing an owned creator community.

Existing relationships within the creator and influencer space.

How to Apply



Please submit your CV or résumé along with examples of creator or influencer work you have personally managed or helped deliver.



Your examples do not need to be presented as a polished case study. Please briefly include:



The creator programs or types of creators you managed

Your specific responsibilities

Campaigns or content you helped produce

Relevant performance results or lessons

Examples of briefs, reports, creator content, trackers, or program systems you developed, if available



Please also answer the following in your application:



How many years of creator or influencer marketing experience do you have?

Have you managed TikTok Shop creators or affiliates?

What performance metrics do you normally track?

What tools have you used to manage creator campaigns?

title: Customer Experience Support Specialist
description:
Perma Products is an internationally recognised supplier of DIY hardware. We pride ourselves on creating truly innovative product ranges which we distribute to customers around the world. Moving from strength to strength, our team is passionate about maintaining a leading position across our brand categories in child safety, pet accessories and home DIY hardware. 



Due to continued growth, we are looking for an experienced customer service professional to join our team in a part-time capacity. If you genuinely enjoy helping people, solving problems and finding the right outcome for customers, we want to hear from you. 



The Role 



This is a part-time role, working 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday. Ideally, hours will be 9:00am to 1:00pm AEST, however, we’re open to flexibility around start and finish times. There may also be an opportunity to transition to full-time hours in the future. 



You will be responsible for responding to a broad range of customer enquiries, from order support and warranty claims through to product advice and installation troubleshooting. Most of the customer contact will be managed through support tickets and live chat, with other customer service channels used as required. 



Responsibilities include: 



- Respond to customer enquiries, primarily through email/support tickets and live chat 

- Provide support across orders, returns, warranty claims, product advice and installation troubleshooting 

- Process warranty claims, replacements, spare parts and other customer resolutions 

- Work across multiple brands, products, sales channels and regions 

- Work with internal teams including operations, warehousing and eCommerce to resolve customer enquiries 

- Accurately record customer interactions, actions and outcomes 

- Identify recurring customer or product issues and escalate these where appropriate 

- Manage multiple enquiries and priorities while maintaining a high level of customer service 



Skills Required 



To be successful in this role, you will be a confident and customer-focused self-starter who enjoys finding solutions and demonstrates the following attributes: 



- Minimum 2 years' experience in customer service, customer experience or customer support 

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills 

- A genuine passion for helping customers and delivering great outcomes 

- Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to work through unfamiliar situations 

- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail 

- Ability to work quickly and accurately in a fast-paced environment 

- Ability to manage multiple enquiries and priorities independently 

- Confidence using online systems and learning new software 

- Experience using a helpdesk or customer support platform such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or similar is highly regarded 

- Experience in eCommerce, retail or consumer products is advantageous 



You don't need to know our products on day one. We will teach you that. What is harder to teach is curiosity, care, attention to detail and the drive to find the right outcome for a customer. 



Think you have what it takes? We want to hear from you. 



Please apply with your resume and a cover letter detailing your suitability for the role.

title: DM Setter / Virtual Assistant for Online Fitness Coach
description:
Hours: 5–7 hours per week to start (with potential to grow as the business grows)

Industry: Online Fitness Coaching

Hi! I run a fast-growing online fitness coaching business helping busy women  (mainly in the US, Europe, and the Middle East) transform their bodies through structured training, nutrition, and accountability.



I'm looking for a high-level Virtual Assistant / DM Setter who can manage Instagram conversations, build relationships with prospects, and book qualified sales calls.



This is not just a message-sending job. I'm looking for someone who can think, communicate naturally, and build real conversations with prospects.



Responsibilities

Instagram DM Management

You will manage and respond to conversations on Instagram including:

• New followers

• Story viewers

• Post interactions

• Commenters

• Warm leads

• Previous leads



Your job is to start conversations, continue them naturally, qualify prospects, and move them toward booking a call.



Lead Qualification

You will ask thoughtful questions to understand:

• Their fitness goals

• Their challenges

• Their motivation to change

• Their timeline

Really try to understand where they are at and what they tried before and didnt work - understanding what is keeping them stuck and why coaching might help 



This helps us identify high-quality prospects.



Sales Call Booking

The goal of conversations is to book  5 calls a week  with qualified leads.

You will guide prospects through the conversation until they are ready to:



• Book a call

• Receive the booking link

• Confirm their call



Bonuses will be paid for calls booked and clients who sign up.



Influencer & Lead Research

You will also help with:

• Finding relevant influencers

• Reaching out for collaborations

• Engaging with their followers

• Identifying potential leads



Conversation Management

You must be able to:

• Have natural conversations (not robotic replies)

• Use the script as a framework, not a rigid template ( all scripts will be provided as well as training ) 

• Ask follow-up questions and dig deeper into responses

• Make prospects feel heard and understood



Training and scripts will be provided.



Requirements

You MUST have experience with:

• Instagram DM setting

• Online coaching businesses (fitness preferred)

• Booking sales calls from DMs

• Lead qualification conversations



You should be comfortable with:



• Sales conversations

• Asking questions confidently

• Handling objections naturally



Important Skills

I'm specifically looking for someone who:

• Communicates naturally and professionally in English

• Reads previous conversations before replying

• Does not send robotic copy/paste responses

• Uses good judgment when speaking with prospects

• Can identify when to ask for help- this is a team work animi always available jump in when needed 

• Takes initiative and ownership



Tools You May Use

• Instagram

• Google Drive

- lead sheet

• Messaging tools ( boards and in future many chat) 

Training will be provided.



Compensation

• Hourly pay 6$

• 5–7 hours per week to start

• Opportunity to increase hours as the business grows

• Bonus for every call booked alone without skipping the DM Flow  5$ 

• Bonus for every client sign-up 10$

There is also room to grow with the business for the right person.



To Apply

Please include:

1?? Your experience with DM setting or online coaching businesses

2?? A screenshot or example conversation where you booked a call

3?? Why you believe you're good at building conversations with prospects





Applications without these will not be considered.



Final Note

I'm looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with the business.

If you are someone who enjoys talking to people, understanding their goals, and helping them take action, this could be a great fit.



Thanks

title: AI Automation & Full-Stack Systems Developer
description:

Work Type: Remote

Schedule: Part-time to start, with opportunity to grow

Industry: Electrical / Commercial Lighting / Construction Sales

Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior



About the Position



We are looking for a highly capable AI Automation & Full-Stack Developer to help us build and improve internal business systems for a commercial lighting and electrical sales/distribution company.



This is not a Virtual Assistant position and is not simply a “ChatGPT prompt” position.



We need someone who can take a business problem, understand the workflow, and then design, code, integrate, test, deploy, and maintain the solution.



Our goal is to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work involving:



Customer
s

Lighting quote requests

Construction bids

Project tracking

Manufacturer/rep pricing

Follow-ups

PDF/document extraction

Lighting fixture schedules

Product matching and value engineering

Purchase orders

Sales orders

CRM updates

Reports and dashboards

Systems You Would Help Build



One of our major projects is an AI-powered sales and bid management system.



For example:



Incoming
 → AI reads
 → identifies customer/project → extracts bid date → determines what is being requested → creates/updates project → assigns follow-up → tracks manufacturer pricing → alerts salesperson → records quote → tracks award/order/delivery



We also want to develop an AI commercial-lighting takeoff and product-crossing system capable of working with construction documents.



Example workflow:



Upload Electrical Plans → Find Lighting Fixture Schedule → Extract Fixture Types → Read Manufacturer/Catalog Numbers → Determine Quantities → Match Fixtures on Plans → Generate Takeoff → Find Approved/VE Alternatives → Produce Excel/PDF Quote Data

AI / LLM Development



OpenAI API

LLM structured outputs

Function/tool calling

AI agents

Node.js

Automation



n8n strongly preferred

Webhooks

REST APIs

JSON

Make/Zapier experience helpful

Scheduled/conditional workflows

Error handling and retry logic



Databases / Backend



PostgreSQL

Supabase or similar platform

SQL

Database design

Authentication/user management

File storage



Business Integrations

Experience integrating systems such as:



Microsoft Outlook

Microsoft Graph API

Google Sheets

Google Drive

Gmail

Google Calendar

Excel

Cloud storage

CRM systems

Document & PDF Automation



Experience processing business documents is extremely valuable.



We work with:



Construction drawings

Electrical plans

Lighting fixture schedules

Specifications

PDFs

Excel files

Manufacturer quotes

Purchase orders

Invoices

Submittals

s and attachments



You should understand how to programmatically extract, structure, validate and store information from these documents.



Experience with PDF parsing, computer vision, OCR, multimodal AI or document AI is a major advantage.



Full-Stack Development



You should be comfortable taking an application from idea to production.



That may include:



Frontend → Backend → Database → API integrations → AI → Authentication → Deployment → Monitoring



Experience with platforms such as the following is useful:



Vercel

Cloudflare

Supabase

AWS

Google Cloud

GitHub



You must be comfortable debugging applications after deployment.



What We're NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if your AI experience consists primarily of:



Using ChatGPT manually

Writing prompts

Creating GPTs without coding

Basic Zapier workflows

Copying AI-generated code without understanding it

Building simple chatbot demos



We need someone who understands how the underlying system works and can troubleshoot it when something breaks.



What We're Looking For in a Person



Technical ability is important, but we also need someone who can:



Understand a business workflow before coding

Ask good questions

Recommend better approaches when appropriate

Work independently

Troubleshoot problems

Test their own work

Communicate clearly

Document systems

Improve existing code

Maintain systems after launch



We do not want someone who disappears after building version 1.



We're looking for someone interested in becoming the technical/AI systems person for the business long term.



Examples of Projects



You may work on projects such as:



AI
 CRM



Automatically analyze incoming and outgoing
s and determine:



Customer

Project

Quote request

Bid deadline

Manufacturer/rep

Pricing status

Required follow-up

Next action



Then automatically update the CRM.



AI Bid Tracker



Track:

Customer

Assigned salesperson

Cost

Extract fixture types

Extract catalog numbers

Count fixtures

Identify controls

Generate Excel takeoffs

Take a specified lighting fixture and find comparable products from alternative manufacturers based on:

Mounting

Dimensions

Distribution/optics

Dimming

Emergency requirements

Sensors/controls

Then generate a side-by-side comparison.



Application Instructions



Please start your application with:



AI SYSTEMS 2026



Applications without this phrase may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following:



How many years have you been programming professionally?

Rate your Python ability from 1–10.

Rate your JavaScript/TypeScript ability from 1–10.

Rate your n8n ability from 1–10.

Describe the most complicated AI automation you've personally built.

Have you integrated OpenAI through the API rather than simply using ChatGPT?

Have you built applications using function/tool calling or structured outputs?

Have you integrated Microsoft Outlook or Microsoft Graph?

Have you built systems using Google Sheets/Drive APIs?

Have you worked with PDF/document extraction?

Have you built a production web application with a database?

Which database platforms have you used?

Where do you normally deploy applications?

Provide your GitHub profile if available.

Provide links/screenshots/videos of systems you've built.

Required Video



Please provide a 3–5 minute Loom video showing us one system you personally built.



Explain:



Problem → Architecture → Automation → AI → Database → Result



Do not just show the user interface.



We want to understand what you personally built and how it works behind the scenes.



Paid Technical Test



Final candidates may be offered a small paid technical test.



Example:



Build a basic workflow that accepts an
 containing:

Customer: ABC Electric

Bid Date: September 30

Request: Please provide lighting pricing.



The system should use AI to return structured data such as:

Customer: ABC Electric

Request Type: Lighting Quote

Bid Date: September 30

Status: Quote Requested

Then save the information to a database or spreadsheet and create the appropriate follow-up.



We care about accuracy, architecture, reliability and maintainability, not just whether the demo works once.



Important



We are interested in a long-term working relationship.



There are multiple systems to build, and successful projects will lead to additional development work.



The right person will have considerable freedom to recommend technologies and improve our processes

title: HR & Payroll Administrator
description:
We are seeking an experienced HR & Payroll Administrator to manage day-to-day payroll and human resources administration for our growing company.



Responsibilities include processing payroll accurately and on time, maintaining employee records, onboarding and offboarding employees, tracking vacation/sick time, assisting with benefits administration, preparing payroll and HR reports, handling employee documentation, maintaining personnel files, and helping ensure compliance with company policies and applicable employment requirements.



The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling confidential employee and payroll information. Experience with payroll software, Microsoft Excel, and general HR administration is required. Experience working with a construction, electrical, low-voltage, security, or field-service company is a plus.



Primary Responsibilities: Process weekly or biweekly payroll; maintain employee timekeeping and payroll records; manage new-hire paperwork and employee onboarding; maintain personnel files; track PTO, sick leave, and employee changes; assist with workers’ compensation and benefits administration; prepare payroll reports and employment documentation; coordinate employee terminations and final paperwork; respond to routine employee HR/payroll questions; and assist management with general administrative and HR duties.



Qualifications: Previous payroll and HR administrative experience; strong attention to detail; excellent organizational and communication skills; ability to maintain confidentiality; proficiency with Excel and payroll/accounting software; and knowledge of California payroll and employment practices strongly preferred.

title: Customer Service Representative for Ecom Fashion Store 👗
description:

We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our Ecom Fashion Dropshipping store.

Because of that, this role starts part-time, and as our order volume grows we're working toward making it a full-time position. We're looking for someone who's open to that path — starting part-time now and stepping up to full-time hours as we scale.

We're building a long-term team of A-players who want to grow with us — not just for a few weeks, but for the long run.



🧠 What We're Looking For



Minimum 1 year of experience in Customer Support.

Proven experience in e-commerce or dropshipping (ideally for a store doing $100K+ in monthly revenue).

Minimum $5K+ earned on the platform (we want to see you've done serious work before).

Experience using Gorgias (our main ticketing platform).

Comfortable working with Gmail / G Suite inbox management.

Strong written English communication skills — clear, friendly, and professional.

Detail-oriented and consistent with tone and accuracy.

Fast response times — you pick up new customer messages quickly; our target is a first reply within 1 hour.

High availability in the London (UK) timezone — ideally able to cover the inbox 7 days a week (including weekends), even if it's only a few hours per day to start.

Open to starting part-time and moving to full-time hours as we scale.



🚀 What We Offer



Long-term position — starting part-time and growing into full-time as we scale (we're looking for someone to stay 6+ months minimum).

Flexible working hours — as long as the inbox gets covered every day.

Weekly or bi-weekly payouts (depending on agreement).

Communication and task management via Discord.

Growth opportunities within the team as we scale.

Salary increases as you grow with us — your pay goes up with consistently strong performance and when the role moves to full-time.

Bonus structure available based on performance and customer satisfaction.



📋 What to Expect After You Apply

If we think you're a fit, we'll send you a short video explaining exactly how we work, what your daily tasks will look like, and what we expect from you.

After watching the video, you can respond with your thoughts — and if it feels like a good match, we'll schedule a call to discuss the next steps.



⚠️ Important

Only apply if:



You've read this entire post carefully.

You meet all the requirements.

You're highly available, okay with covering the inbox 7 days a week, and quick to respond.

You're serious about joining a long-term team that values hard work and consistency.



If you're interested, start your application with the word "apple" — that's how we know you've actually read this post. Applications without it won't be considered.



If that's you — we can't wait to meet you. 💪

title: Video Podcast Editor (Part Time, 15 to 20 Hours Per Week)
description:
I am looking for a video podcast editor who can take multi-camera interview footage and turn it into episodes people watch all the way through. This is a part-time role, roughly 15 to 20 hours per week, with steady weekly work for the right person.



This job is about pacing and polish. Two people talking for an hour only holds attention if the editor knows when to cut, when to breathe, and when to drop in something visual. That is the skill I am hiring for.



Here is what you need to be able to do.



- Cut multiple camera shots together, with quick cuts between speakers so the conversation feels alive

- Clean up audio, balance levels, and remove background noise so every voice sounds clear

- Add lower thirds, intros, outros, and graphic overlays

- Pull sound and moments from outtakes and layer them in where they add energy

- Add B-roll, graphics, and royalty free background music that fits the tone

- Find your own B-roll for custom projects in a technical industry, sourcing footage from the companies we interview or from public projects on YouTube



That last point matters more than you might think. Our episodes cover a technical field, and I will not always hand you a folder of clips. I need someone who can research the guest, find relevant footage of their facilities and projects, and work it into the edit without being asked. Attention to detail is everything in this role, so when you apply, put the word "cucumber" in your email subject line.



The main deliverable is full podcast episodes, whatever gets thrown at you. On top of that, you will create clips and shorts from each episode for social. If you have experience uploading and publishing to YouTube, Apple Podcasts, or Spotify, tell me, because that is a big plus and part of where I want this role to go.



Here is how the hiring process works. First, there is a free test task. I will send you two shots with audio, and your job is to cut them together into one engaging scene of about 10 minutes. If that goes well, I will give you a longer paid test task, which will be a full podcast episode. If you pass both, the job is yours on a part-time, weekly basis.



I pay twice a month via Wise, on the 1st and 16th. The payment on the 16th covers work from the 1st to the 15th, and the payment on the 1st covers the 16th through the end of the month.



To apply, email me directly at 
 not use the OnlineJobs.ph messaging system, I do not check those messages. Include links to podcast episodes you have edited, and any shorts or clips that performed well.



Looking forward to finding an editor who makes every episode better than the raw footage deserves.

title: Assistant Quantity Surveyor & Project Coordinator – UK Insurance Repairs
description:
We are a UK-based insurance claims management and building repair company looking for a part-time Assistant Quantity Surveyor & Project Coordinator to support our growing team.



The role combines quantity surveying, estimating and practical project coordination. You will work alongside our Claims Assessors, administrative team and contractors on residential insurance repair and reinstatement projects across the UK.



Key responsibilities include:



* Preparing and reviewing detailed Schedules of Works (SOW)

* Quantity take-offs and measurements from photographs, plans and survey information

* Preparing material lists for residential repair and reinstatement works

* Estimating labour and material costs

* Reviewing and comparing contractor quotations

* Preparing Bills of Quantities and cost breakdowns where required

* Assisting with procurement and obtaining supplier quotations

* Coordinating material orders and deliveries with contractors

* Monitoring approved values, contractor costs, materials and expected project margins

* Recording and assessing variations during works

* Supporting the team with technical construction queries

* Maintaining clear project records and cost-control spreadsheets



Our projects mainly involve residential property repairs following insured damage, including water damage, fire damage and subsidence. Typical works include strip-out, drying, plastering, decorating, flooring, kitchens, bathrooms, carpentry, plumbing and electrical works.



Ideal candidate:



* Degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management or similar

* Experience in quantity surveying, estimating or construction costing

* Strong Excel skills

* Experience with take-off/estimating software such as PlanSwift, Bluebeam, CostX or similar

* Able to read construction drawings and understand residential building works

* Good written and spoken English

* Highly organised and comfortable working remotely

* UK construction experience is desirable but not essential



Experience in UK insurance reinstatement work is an advantage but not required, as training will be provided.



We are initially looking for approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity for the role to grow as the business expands.

We provide a lot of support and guidance along the way, but we need someone who's genuinely up for anything, organised enough to keep multiple moving parts on track and comfortable being part of a busy, collaborative team. A big part of this role is taking on the day-to-day project and ad hoc work so our senior leaders can stay focused on the bigger picture, the more you can take off their plate, the more impact you'll have.



**Who We're Looking For**



- Fluent written and spoken English, this role involves regular participation in team meetings

- A genuine team player who collaborates well and communicates clearly

- Confident using the Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar)

- Proficient in Asana, or quick to pick it up

- Comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently

- Comfortable managing calendars, correspondence and documentation with accuracy

- Proactive and adaptable, happy to take on a wide variety of tasks, big or small

- Someone who can be trusted with sensitive information and exercises good judgement

- Shopify knowledge is a plus

- E-commerce experience or knowledge is a plus

**What You'll Do**

🛍️ A brand customers are genuinely obsessed with

📈 Room to grow as the business scales



If you're highly organised, love being part of a team, and are ready to take on whatever comes your way, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations Manager For The 'Disney' Of Short-Stays
description:
We’re looking for a high-ownership operator who takes full responsibility for outcomes, solves problems without being asked, and ensures leadership never has to step in, someone with the ambition and appetite to help build the world’s next Disney and grow with it long-term, and use this opportunity to fundamentally change the trajectory of their working career.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We are a multi-award-winning, market-leading company at the forefront of experiential hospitality, creating spaces that don’t just get booked… they get remembered by transporting guests to entirely different worlds.



Lauded by Forbes as the “Disney of short stays”.



This is not a company you join to “do a job.”

This is a company you join to build something bigger than yourself.



And we are looking for the operator who wants to be at the centre of it.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



The Role:



Leadership’s phones should not ring.



- No chaos reaching the top.

- No unresolved issues.

- No repeated problems.



You are the person who sees everything, fixes everything, and builds systems so it never happens again.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What You’ll Actually Do



1. Own operations across a fast-moving, multi-layered business

2. Identify problems before they become problems

3. Build systems, structure, and accountability where they don’t exist

4. Run consistent team touchpoints to maintain performance and clarity

5. Ensure everything moves from created ? executed ? verified

6. Act as the control centre of the business — nothing slips

7. Use the team to execute, but you own the thinking and direction

8. Uphold brand standards at all times, internally and externally



Execution & Systems

9. Build, document, and continuously improve SOPs, playbooks, and workflows

10. Ensure standards are not just created, but actually followed and enforced

11. Remove friction across the business (delays, confusion, bottlenecks, poor handoffs)

12. Continuously optimise operations to make the business smoother and more scalable

13. Solve root problems permanently, not just surface-level issues

14. Ensure timelines (turnovers, readiness, maintenance, guest experience) are always met



People, Team & Leadership

15. Hire, assess, and position the right people in the right roles

16. Train tea
mbers to a high standard so they can operate independently

17. Hold the team accountable to performance, behaviour, and standards

18. Run daily/weekly check-ins and maintain consistent communication rhythms

19. Recognise, motivate, and elevate team performance consistently

20. Build a culture of ownership, reliability, and accountability

21. Address performance issues early and directly (no avoidance of hard conversations)



Communication & Control

22. Ensure all communication is clear, direct, timely, and actionable

23. Eliminate vagueness, missed ownership, and slow responses

24. Actively monitor conversations, tasks, and outputs to understand what’s really happening

25. Ensure no issue goes unowned or unresolved

26. Keep leadership completely shielded from day-to-day operational noise



Decision-Making & Ownership

27. Make fast, high-quality decisions without waiting for permission

28. Take full ownership of outcomes, not just tasks

29. Escalate only when necessary, and do so clearly and with context

30. Never allow “that’s not my job” thinking to exist within the team



Guest Experience & Brand Protection

31. Protect and enhance the guest experience across all stages (before, during, after stay)

32. Ensure operations consistently match the brand promise

33. Identify and fix anything that could negatively impact the guest experience

34. Maintain a “show mindset”, every detail contributes to the overall experience



Visibility, Truth & Awareness

35. Stay fully aware of what is happening across the business at all times

36. Do not rely solely on reports, actively seek the truth

37. Identify where things are breaking, slowing down, or slipping

38. Be present, visible, and engaged with the team daily



Continuous Improvement

39. Constantly identify what can be improved, simplified, or upgraded

40. Redesign systems, processes, and workflows as the business scales

41. Stay ahead, continuously improve your own skills across operations, leadership, and systems

42. Leave the business better than you found it every single day



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What This Role Really Is



You will have fixed hours and structure.



But this is not a “do your hours and switch off” role.



There will be 
nts where the business needs more from you.

There will be times where problems don’t fit neatly into a schedule.



And in those 
nts, you step up.



This role is designed for someone who understands that:



This is hospitality, the clock never stops. You build first, then you are rewarded for what you’ve built.



Not the other way around.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Leadership Standard (Read Carefully)



We believe leadership is not about control, it’s about contribution.



Great leaders are givers.



They give:



- Time

- Attention

- Coaching

- Correction

- Energy

- Standards

- Stability

- Direction



This does not mean being soft.

It means you take responsibility for outcomes beyond yourself.



Leaders who take, attention, credit, comfort, convenience, excuses, weaken organisations.



Leaders who give, build them.



In return, they earn:



- Trust

- Loyalty

- Performance

- Growth

- Credibility



If this is how you naturally operate, you will thrive here.



If not, this role will feel overwhelming very quickly.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Non-Negotiables



1, Exceptional English communication skills (spoken and written)

2. Extreme ownership mindset

3. High reliability, you do what you say, every time

4. Ability to think independently and solve problems without direction

5. Willingness to go beyond what is expected when the business requires it

6. Pride in building something long-term, not just completing tasks



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



What This Role Is NOT



- Not a 9–5 mindset role

- Not a delegation-only role

- Not a “wait for instructions” role



If something breaks, you own the outcome.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Compensation



During the initial 6-month probation period, this role will be compensated at:



$1,500 AUD per month



This period is designed to establish:



1. Your level of ownership

2. Your ability to operate independently

3. Your impact on stabilising and improving the business



This is not a static role, and this is not a static salary.



At the end of the probation period, your compensation will be restructured into a higher rate based on your performance, reliability, and overall impact on the business.



High performers in this role will not remain at entry-level compensation.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



How to Think About This Role



This position is built for someone who understands that:



1. You are not paid based on time alone, you are paid based on value created

2. The more problems you solve and systems you build, the more valuable you become

3. As the business grows stronger through your contribution, your compensation grows with it



We are looking to invest in someone long-term, someone who wants to grow into a key operator within the business, not just complete a probation period. We reward ownership, consistency, and results. If you come in, take full control, solve problems, and lift the level of the business, you will be recognised and compensated accordingly.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Time Tracking & Standards



This role requires the use of Time Doctor.



This is not about micromanagement or unnecessary oversight.



It exists for one reason: to protect standards across the team.



We operate in a high-performance environment where:



1. Everyone is working hard

2. Everyone is contributing

3. Everyone is held to the same level of accountability



Time tracking ensures:



1. Fairness across the team

2. Visibility on where time is being invested

3. Alignment on effort and output

4. No one carrying more than they should, and no one contributing less than expected

5. A strong understanding of what your salary should look like post probation



You will have the flexibility to:



1. Think creatively

2. Step away when needed for problem-solving

3. Work in a way that allows you to perform at a high level



Listening to music, having something on in the background, and working in your own flow is completely fine.



What matters is:

You are consistently contributing, moving things forward, and operating at a high standard alongside your fellow tea
mbers.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



MANDATORY APPLICATION REQUIREMENT (READ CAREFULLY)



To apply, you must submit a video answering the questions below via a public google drive OR Loom link.



Applications without a video will not be considered. Ai should not be used to create scripts, this should come directly from you. Without being read off a screen. We want a raw version of who you are.



In your video, answer:



1. What is your understanding of the role based on the job post?

2. Walk us through how you would handle this scenario:

"A guest checks in at 3PM. At 12PM, the clean isn’t done, keys aren’t returned, and no one has confirmed readiness."

3. Being in Hospitality, the clock never stops, meaning sometimes you'll be working more than 40 hours a week, even sometimes 60 hours+ a week. Why do you want to be part of building something like this? Especially considering how demanding it is vs a traditional role.

4. If you were told you were joining the Disney of short-stays, how would you respond?



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Final Note



This role is not for everyone.



But for the right person, it becomes something far more than a job.



You become:



1. The person leadership relies on

2. The person the team looks to

3. The person who holds the standard

4. The person who is remmunerated heavily because of that



And a key part of building something that will become globally iconic.



If that excites you, we want to hear from you.

description:
Job Title: Multimedia Editor (Football / Soccer Niche)

Shift: 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT — Aligned with European working hours



Positions Available: 2 Openings



Position 1: Immediate Start (Urgent)



Position 2: Start within 1 week



About the Role

We are a fast-growing sports media brand living and breathing football (soccer) culture. As we expand our marketing strategy across social media and YouTube, we are looking for two skilled Multimedia Editors specializing in both short-form and long-form content to scale our production capacity.



In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-retention TikToks, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, as well as editing polished, engaging long-form YouTube videos (documentaries, listicles, match breakdowns, and video podcasts). If you understand football culture, master pacing across different video formats, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Production: Edit fast-paced, high-retention short-form videos (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) utilizing strong hooks, trending sounds, dynamic text overlays, motion graphics, and sound effects.



Long-Form Video Editing: Structure and edit compelling long-form YouTube videos (e.g., mini-documentaries, narrative breakdowns, tactical analysis, listicles), maintaining strong viewer retention and narrative flow.



Football Culture & Trend Integration: Seamlessly incorporate match footage, statistics, memes, news clips, sound effects, and culturally relevant football banter into edits.



Thumbnail & Graphic Assets: Create or assist with high-CTR thumbnails and visual assets tailored for long-form YouTube and short-form platforms.



Fast-Turnaround News Edits: Rapidly edit quick-reaction content to capitalize on breaking news, viral matchday moments, and trending football topics.



Platform Optimization: Tailor edits to platform-specific specs (aspect ratios, pacing, safe zones, hooks, and retention strategies).



Team Collaboration: Work closely with our Marketing Strategist via ClickUp to manage video pipelines, revisions, and release schedules efficiently.



Qualifications & Requirements

Format Expertise: Proven specialization in editing both short-form (vertical 9:16) and long-form (horizontal 16:9) videos with high viewer retention rates.



Niche Passion & Knowledge: Deep understanding of global football (leagues, teams, players, tactical narratives, and social media football culture/memes).



Software Proficiency: Expert command of Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro. Strong skills in After Effects (motion graphics, animated lower-thirds, tracking) and CapCut are highly preferred.



Portfolio / Showreel: Must submit a portfolio featuring examples of both short-form and long-form football/sports edits demonstrating strong pacing, audio design, and narrative flow.



Speed & Reliability: Ability to deliver polished edits on schedule during tight deadlines and fast-moving matchdays.



Full-Time Focus: Ability to dedicate 100% of your professional focus to this role (strictly no freelancing, side gigs, or second jobs).



Schedule Alignment: Able to consistently work 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT, Monday to Friday.



Remote Work Setup: High-performance editing rig, fast internet connection, and proficiency with remote tools like ClickUp.



What We Offer

Salary: ?27,000 – ?30,000 / month



Growth Potential: Opportunity to advance into a Lead Multimedia Editor or Creative Producer role as our media outlet grows.



100% remote working setup.



Work directly on exciting content within the global sports media ecosystem.



Collaborative, fast-paced, and passionate team culture.

title: Corporate Lodging Specialist & B2B Sales Professional (30–35 Hours/Week)
description:
Company: Confidential / Growing U.S. Corporate & Government Housing Provider



Industry: Corporate Housing / Mid-Term Rentals / B2B Lodging



Required Platforms: 
, CLC Lodging, FedRooms, National Corporate Housing, SilverDoor



Job Overview:

We are a rapidly growing corporate lodging and government housing provider. We are seeking an elite, proactive Corporate Lodging & B2B Sales Professional to act as a right-hand operational partner for a dedicated 30 to 35-hour-per-week role.

This is a high-level sales and operations role. You must come to the table already knowing how to navigate complex B2B housing platforms, execute corporate legal paperwork, manage diverse invoicing/billing structures, and most importantly—hunt for leads and close lodging contracts.

Operating Standards & Role Evolution (Read Carefully)

 * Comprehensive Role Ownership & Agility: We operate in a fast-paced, high-growth commercial environment where platform priorities and day-to-day requirements naturally evolve. We expect a right-hand partner who embraces operational agility. Rather than adhering to a rigid task list, you will be expected to take full ownership of the role—seamlessly managing any operational, administrative, or outreach task needed to support and expand our lodging portfolio.

 * Firm Compensation Terms: Your hourly rate covers your contracted 30–35 hours of high-level execution. Adding new platforms, managing varied lead funnels, learning updated workflows, or executing broader administrative duties within your working hours is baseline performance and does not trigger out-of-cycle rate renegotiations.

Core Responsibilities

 * Platform Registration & Portfolio Management: You must be highly proficient in navigating, setting up, and managing property profiles across the following specific networks:

   * 

   * CLC Lodging (Corpay)

   * FedRooms (GSA Official Program)

   * National Corporate Housing

   * SilverDoor Apartments

   * Note: You are also expected to actively research, call, and acquire contracts from other corporate housing networks.

 * Strategic B2B Outreach & Closing: Make proactive outbound phone calls to corporate travel managers, prime contractor project managers, and insurance ALE adjusters. You are expected to hunt for leads, pitch our housing, and close the contracts.

 * End-to-End Paperwork & Billing: You will be responsible for issuing and managing the six core B2B housing documents via GoHighLevel:

   * Corporate Master Lodging Agreements

   * Third-Party Credit Card Authorization Forms

   * Crew / Guest Occupancy Acknowledgments

   * Consolidated GSA Per Diem Invoice Templates

   * State Tax Exemption Forms

   * Property Intake & Condition Surveys

 * Pipeline & Phone Operations in GoHighLevel (GHL): Log all lead activity, answer incoming inquiries, operate the integrated phone system, and manage end-to-end booking pipelines inside GoHighLevel daily. You must understand how to process immediate payments as well as manage Net-30 accounts.

Requirements

 * Schedule & Time Zone: 30 to 35 hours per week during U.S. Central Time (CDT/CST) business hours.

 * Specialized Industry Familiarity: You must have a prior background specifically in mid-term rentals, corporate housing, government lodging platforms, and direct B2B sales outreach.

 * Technical Experience: Proven working knowledge and proficiency inside GoHighLevel (GHL) is required.

 * Spoken English & Phone Confidence: High fluency and clear, professional spoken English. You must be comfortable making direct outbound calls to U.S. corporations, government personnel, and insurance adjusters to close deals.

Compensation, Milestones & Bonuses

We do not pay people to learn on our time. We pay for established expertise and results. Your first 90 days are a probationary period to prove you can independently navigate these platforms and close contracts.

 * First 90 Days (The "Prove It" Phase): You will receive a base pay of $4.00/hour. In addition, you will earn a $50.00 cash commission for every mid-term booking that you successfully generate a lead for, close, and is fully paid by the client.

 * After 90 Days (Graduation to Senior Rate): Once you have proven you are a true specialist who can manage the pipeline and close deals without hand-holding, your base rate will automatically increase to a flat $10.00/hour. (Please note: Upon graduating to this higher, stable senior hourly rate, the $50 per booking commission is removed).

 * Monthly Team KPI & Goal Bonus (Up to $55/Month): Regardless of your base rate, you have the opportunity to earn a fixed performance bonus each month broken down as follows:

   * $15 for maintaining a 15-minute response time to team messages during active work hours.

   * $10 for logging in and working on time every day (punctuality and attendance).

   * $20 for strict KPI maintenance (zero broken GHL pipelines, zero missed calls).

   

 * Health Stipend: $30/month contribution toward personal insurance.

To Apply, You Must Include the Following:

Please reply with "Corporate Housing Specialist" in your subject line and include:

 * A brief summary of your direct experience with GoHighLevel. You must also explicitly state which of the specific platforms we listed above (
, CLC Lodging, FedRooms, National Corporate Housing, and SilverDoor) you have actively worked with.

 * A description of how you handle direct outbound sales calls, and how you manage the difference between immediate corporate credit card billing vs. Net-30 monthly invoicing.

 * A link to a 1- to 2-minute video or audio recording introducing yourself, detailing your B2B lodging background, and demonstrating your spoken English and phone presence (Loom, unlisted YouTube, or Google Drive link).

We have an immediate opening for a polished, fluent MALE English speaker to join our team in a client-facing communications role.



You will be making outbound contact with people who already know us, walking them through an opportunity, and transferring them to the right person internally. This is not a sales role — you are the first point of contact, not the closer.



WHAT YOU GET PAID

$500–$1,000 every week. The exact amount is confirmed and agreed before your trial period begins.



HOURS

This is a full time position — 40 hours per week.

You select your own 8-hour daily window, anywhere within 9AM–12PM UK time.



HARD REQUIREMENTS



Spoken English that is fluent and effectively accent-free. You will be speaking with professionals across Europe and beyond. How you sound matters.

Full time commitment — 40 hours weekly, no exceptions and no side arrangements

Fast and reliable internet

A dedicated quiet space — background noise is not acceptable

A clear audio setup — phone or headset, quality matters

Real phone-based work experience. Whether that is inside sales, appointment setting, or client success — you need a track record of professional phone conversations.



WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT



Everyone you call already has a relationship with us — no cold outreach ever

You are not responsible for closing — your job ends when you hand off the call

A close-knit remote team, mostly based in the Philippines — approachable and easy to work with

Work from wherever you are, as long as your environment and connection are solid



HOW TO APPLY

Send a voice note that covers:



Who you are and where you are based

Your phone-based work history — specific roles, results, and numbers where possible

Why you want this position and what makes you a good fit



Send to 



We aim to respond within 48 hours. Keep notifications on — we move quickly and expect the same.



Voice messages only. Any other format will be ignored.



DO NOT APPLY IF:



Your English has a noticeable accent

You cannot guarantee a quiet dedicated space for calls

Your internet drops or is inconsistent

You are looking for part time work or something secondary

You have no experience in phone-based professional roles

Working UK morning hours is not possible for you



The team is growing. People who come in at this stage have room to move up. If you are dependable, take direction well, and know how to handle a professional call — we want to hear from you.

title: Tiktok Shop VA - viral ai product creator
description:
We're looking for an affiliate who lives on TikTok and knows how to turn a trending format into a sale.



What you'll do



Research daily. Track the formats, hooks, and products that are breaking through, and spot which ones fit the Slay Supply catalog.



Adapt, don't copy. Take proven content ideas and build your own version around our products — your footage, your delivery, their structure.



Sharpen the copy. Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to tighten hooks, slide text, captions, CTAs, and angles until they stop the scroll.



Make it convert. Every video should give the viewer a clear reason to stop, watch, and buy.



Link it right. Correct TikTok Shop product link on every post, verified before it goes live.



Post at volume. Up to 50 posts per day.



Stay organized. Keep a content tracker with product source, inspiration, hook, caption, link, and posting status.



Double down on winners. Watch the numbers, find the formats that perform, and build more variations of them.



Follow the rules. Full compliance with TikTok's content, copyright, advertising, and TikTok Shop policies — including Commercial Music Library sounds on Shop-linked posts and original footage only.



Who this is for



You're fast, consistent, and comfortable producing at scale. You understand that volume without organization is wasted effort, and that the tracker is what turns a good week into a repeatable one.

title: Client Success Manager - Remote
description:
Non negotiables:

*Please do not apply if you already have an existing work, there is a time tracker for this role.

*Salary is fixed at $1400/month

*Must not have schedule restrictions. Work hours are Pacific Standard Time based.

*Introduction Video or Audio link is required. Only purpose is to review ahead the level of the English communication skills and shortlist the qualified candidates.







🏢 About the Role : The Client Success Manager plays a vital role in maintaining strong and lasting client relationships. First Point of Contact: Act as the primary liaison for all client inquiries across email, text, and phone calls, ensuring timely responses.



Escalation & Resolution: Handle client escalations quickly, resolve issues, and update internal platforms accordingly.



Onboarding & Meetings: Support onboarding processes and assist during scheduled client meetings.



Proactive Follow-Ups: Conduct outbound follow-up calls when additional assistance is needed and address issues early before they escalate.



Script & Process Management: Receive training to fully manage client call processes and script updates via a CRM Script Editor.



Independent Ownership: Work independently and consistently meet expectations without requiring micromanagement.



✅ Qualifications & Requirements⭐ Preferred Qualifications:

Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in a Customer Success Manager role.



Communication: Strong written and spoken English communication skills with a neutral or excellent speaking accent.



Tech Savvy: Highly adaptable to new platforms and digital workflows.



🛠️ Tools & Platforms:

Gmail & Google Spreadsheets



RingCentral (Preferred but not required)



💻 Technical & Workspace Requirements:

Hardware: Minimum of 16GB RAM for smooth multitasking.



Infrastructure: Reliable backup power source and backup Internet Service Provider (ISP).



Flexibility: Willingness to adjust schedule during urgent or emergency situations.

title: Customer Service & Appointment Booking Specialist (English, US Market)
description:
AB Beauty Studios is a US-based beauty and med spa offering laser hair removal, injectable treatments, and permanent makeup services.



We are looking for a customer service and appointment booking specialist to handle incoming leads, communicate with clients in English, and convert inquiries into confirmed appointments.



Responsibilities



• Respond to potential clients through Instagram messages.

• Answer incoming calls and call back clients who submitted inquiries.

• Explain our services and help clients choose the appropriate treatment.

• Handle objections and guide clients toward booking an appointment.

• Schedule and update appointments in our CRM.

• Monitor our Instagram chatbot and correct conversations when needed.

• Follow the scripts and instructions provided by our team.



Requirements



• Strong spoken and written English, at least upper-intermediate level (B2 or higher).

• Confident and comfortable speaking with US clients by phone.

• Customer service, sales, call center, or appointment-setting experience is preferred.

• Friendly, persuasive, responsible, and attentive to detail.

• Able to respond quickly to new inquiries during working hours.

• Reliable computer, headset, and stable internet connection.



Schedule



Sunday, Monday, and Tuesday, from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM New York time. A different schedule may be discussed if necessary.



Compensation



• Fixed pay of $10 per working day.

• Additional bonuses for successfully booked clients.

• A specialist working three days per week typically earns $500 or more per month, depending on performance and the number of booked appointments.

• Payments are made twice per month.

• One-week paid trial period.



Training



We provide ready-to-use English scripts, instructions for handling messages and calls, and a three-hour online training session covering our CRM and booking system.



To apply, please include a brief summary of your customer service or sales experience and your English level. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to provide a short English voice recording.

title: Full-Time WFH Content Feedback Manager — $1,000–$1,200/month + Bonuses
description:
Salary: Start at $800 a month + performance-based bonuses (TOTAL: $1,000–$1,200 a month once trained)

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form to apply: 
/to/O40RINeW



Important note: Put "CFM" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.



P.S. Once hired for this position, you will be hired and contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC
