title: Full-Time WFH Customer Success and Retention Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

description:
Freight Operations Manager / Team Leader — Remote Philippines



Company: Emerald Global Logistics (EGL)

Location: Remote, Philippines

ABOUT EGL



Emerald Global Logistics is a growing Australian logistics business coordinating international shipments, including vehicles, machinery, furniture and personal effects.



We currently service Australia, Ireland and the UK, with plans to expand into additional international markets. We are looking for an experienced Freight Operations Manager to take ownership of daily shipments and manage our remote team.



THE ROLE



You will keep shipments organised, customers informed and employees accountable. You must be comfortable making operational decisions, solving problems and working independently while keeping the business owner updated.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage international shipments from booking through to delivery.

• Escalate major costs, risks and decisions requiring owner approval.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



• Ideally five or more years of international freight forwarding or logistics experience.

• Previous experience supervising employees or leading an operations team.

• Strong practical knowledge of ocean freight, including full-container and shared-container shipments.

• Experience coordinating imports, exports and shipping documentation.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong organisation, attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Confidence using spreadsheets, shipment trackers and freight or CRM systems.

• Reliable internet, a suitable computer and a quiet workspace.



Experience with Australian, UK or Irish shipping routes, vehicle shipments, machinery or personal effects will be highly regarded.

title: VA - AD researcher
description:
Hello, and thanks for stopping by.



We are a fast-growing European health and wellness brand focused on
 and Instagram advertising.



We are building a strong creative research system and are looking for someone who can grow with us long term.



## What this role is



Your job is to help us understand what the best brands in our space are advertising and what patterns show up across their ads.



You will research 10 brands in the Meta Ad Library and record what you find in a Google Sheet we have already built for you.



You will track things like:



* Which ad formats they use

* What kind of proof they use

* Who the ad seems to be speaking to



You will also save selected screenshots in Google Drive.



The categories are already defined, so you will have a clear system to follow.



The first week is a full mapping of all 10 brands. After that, the work is around 3 hours per week to check what is new.



## One rule that matters a lot



An ad only goes into the sheet if all three are true:



1. It is a static image ad

2. It has been running for at least 30 days

3. It does NOT show the "Low impression count" label



If it has that label, we do not include it.



## Who we are looking for



Someone careful, curious and genuinely interested in advertising.



Accuracy matters much more than speed.



Marketing experience is a plus, but not required. What matters is that you enjoy research, spotting patterns and understanding why ads work.



The main judgement call is noticing when two ads look different but are built around the same core idea.



We will give you clear instructions and examples.



## What we offer



* Clear written processes

* One agreed delivery day per week

* No screen tracking

* Reliable, on-time payment

* A paid two-week trial

* Room to grow into more hours, responsibility and research work



If we work well together, the person who learns our brand and research system now will be the first person we come to as the role grows.



## To apply



Start your message with the word LETSWORK. 



Then answer these three questions in your own words:



1. You are looking at 200 ads from one brand. Your job is to group them into a small number of core ideas. What would you look at to d
 which ads belong together?

2. What is one thing about this job you think you would find difficult?

3. What is your hourly rate?



Short answers are completely fine.



We reply to everyone who follows these steps.



Thanks for reading. We look forward to meeting you.

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.



We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.



You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form Video Editing



Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes

Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content



Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow



Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction

Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction

Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets

title: Logo Research and Vector Recreation Assistant — Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
# Logo Research and Image Restoration Assistant



We are looking for careful graphic designers and research assistants to replace approximately 600 old, low-quality logo files with accurate, clean versions for a large online database.



This is accuracy and production work—not creative logo design. Several applicants may be hired, depending on quality, availability and the number of approved logos they can reliably complete per hour.



## Responsibilities



* Identify the correct logo from the information provided.

* Search official websites, archived websites and other reliable sources for the best available version.

* Use an existing high-quality logo whenever one can be found.

* Improve or reconstruct low-resolution logos when no suitable version is available.

* Use AI-assisted upscaling, image restoration or reconstruction where this saves time.

* Carefully compare every result with the original logo.

* Preserve the original wording, symbols, typography, colours, spacing and proportions.

* Remove unwanted backgrounds and produce a clean, transparent image.

* Export files according to the required naming and formatting rules.

* Flag uncertain identities, unreadable text or conflicting logo versions instead of guessing.

* Maintain a spreadsheet recording the source and status of every logo.



## Required Skills



* Strong image-editing skills using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Affinity Designer or equivalent software.

* Experience restoring, upscaling, cleaning or recreating low-quality logos.

* Ability to use AI image tools effectively while detecting and correcting AI errors.

* Good online research skills.

* Excellent attention to lettering, symbols, colours, spacing and alignment.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions consistently.

* Good written English.

* Reliable communication and careful file organisation.



Vector-editing experience is useful but is not required for every logo.



## Deliverables



For each approved logo:



* A clean, high-resolution PNG with a transparent background.

* At least 1,200 pixels on the longest side, unless instructed otherwise.

* Original aspect ratio and proportions preserved.

* Correct colour profile suitable for website use.

* Correct file name.

* Source URL and a brief source note.

* SVG or another vector file when an official vector version is readily available or the logo can be recreated easily as vector artwork.



A vector file is not required for every logo.



The final result must remain visually faithful to the original. Do not modernise, redesign, simplify or invent missing elements. AI-assisted work is permitted, but obvious AI errors—including altered lettering, distorted symbols, incorrect spacing and invented details—are not acceptable.



## Paid Test



Shortlisted candidates will receive the same paid test involving five logos of varying difficulty.



The test will assess:



* Correct identification of each logo.

* Quality and reliability of the sources.

* Visual accuracy of the restored logo.

* Correct lettering, symbols, colours and proportions.

* Clean transparent backgrounds and edges.

* File organisation and naming.

* Ability to recognise and report uncertainty.

* Number of approved logos completed per hour.



Applicants who complete the test successfully may be offered 30–40 hours of work per week until the main collection is completed. Further work may be available afterwards.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction.

2. Examples of logos or images you have restored from poor-quality originals.

3. Before-and-after examples, if available.

4. The image-editing and AI tools you use.

5. Your preferred hourly rate.

6. Your weekly availability.

7. How many hours per week you can work during the next four weeks.

8. A brief explanation of how you verify that you have found the correct logo.

9. The words **“Exact Logo Recreation”** at the beginning of your application.



We need someone who is patient, methodical and capable of producing accurate, clean results efficiently. Canva-only experience is unlikely to be sufficient.



## Salary



US$5 per hour.



Successful applicants may receive 30–40 hours of work per week. Work will initially be assigned in small paid batches. Further hours will depend on accuracy, reliability and the number of approved logos produced per hour.



The five-logo selection test will be paid.



There are no fixed working hours or time-zone requirements. You may complete the work whenever you prefer, provided you meet the deadline and accurately record the time spent on each logo.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
About Reps Health



Reps Health builds fully custom native iOS and Android coaching apps for fitness trainers and coaches, plus the trainer portal that powers them. Coaches use the platform to build their programs, manage clients, track food and training data, message their client base, and run community features, all under their own brand rather than a shared white-label shell. We're a small founder-led team scaling a growing client pipeline of real coaching businesses, and we're bringing on a contract full-stack developer to help us build more reliably as that pipeline grows.



The Role



This is a full-stack role spanning new feature development and ongoing bug fixing across our Angular/Ionic front end and our AWS/DynamoDB/Node.js backend. You'll be working on the actual systems coaches use every day to run their businesses: program builders, client tracking tools, nutrition logging, in-app messaging, and community features.



Onboarding approach: rather than being thrown straight into building, your first few days will be spent testing the existing platform — running through our product creation flows as a coach would, poking at edge cases, and logging what you find. This gets you genuinely familiar with how the app actually works day-to-day, not just the codebase, before you start shipping changes. Bugs and gaps you find in this period become your first real tickets.



After onboarding, the role settles into a mix of:



Bug fixing from a prioritised, severity-tagged backlog, not ad hoc firefighting

New feature development, working from scoped and signed-off feature specs

Contributing to a monthly system test suite that keeps our product creation flows reliable as we onboard more coaches and clients



What We're Looking For



Full-stack, comfortable owning a feature end to end — front end, API, and data layer

AWS — solid hands-on experience (Lambda, API Gateway, Amplify or similar); tell us what you've actually built with it

DynamoDB — real experience modelling and querying NoSQL data, not just "used it once"

Node.js — backend/API development

Angular — front-end development; Ionic/Capacitor experience is a strong plus, since our app is a hybrid mobile app

Someone who tests their own work properly before calling it done. This matters more to us than raw output speed, especially since bugs here affect real coaches running live client programs

A good communicator — you'll be working directly with the founders, not through layers of process



Nice to Have



Experience with mobile app builds (iOS/Android via Capacitor or similar)

Past experience in a small startup or founder-led environment

QA or test-writing background

Any prior exposure to fitness, wellness, or coaching platforms (not required, just a bonus if the domain already feels familiar)



How to Apply



Send us:



A short note on your relevant experience with our stack (AWS, DynamoDB, Node.js, Angular)

Links to relevant past work (GitHub, portfolio, or apps you've shipped)

title: Virtual Assistant (Research & Outreach Support — UK Real Estate)
description:
20 hours per week · Remote (Philippines) · UK business hours



**About us**



Adino Property Group is a Manchester-based property management company. We work with a network of residential properties across Greater Manchester and supply housing to councils, social housing providers and supported accommodation operators across the North West. It's a small, fast-moving operation and this role sits directly with the director.



**The role**



You are the research and administrative engine behind two things: our outreach to organisations that need housing, and the pipeline of properties we bring in to supply them.



On the outreach side, the director handles the substantive conversations. You make those conversations possible — working out who the decision-maker actually is, confirming their direct line and email, preparing the background, booking the slot, and tracking every follow-up date.



On the property side, you'll be in direct contact with landlords and letting agents: making the approach, answering straightforward questions about what we offer, and getting viewings into the diary.



**Day to day**



*Research and contact mapping*



- Research and build target lists across four groups: local authorities, social housing providers and registered providers, supported accommodation operators, and supported living providers — covering Greater Manchester and the wider North West, including Lancashire, Cheshire and Merseyside

- For each organisation, identify named contacts, job titles, direct dials, email formats, and any published landlord or property-sourcing scheme

- Use LinkedIn search from your own personal account to identify officers and managers by job title and organisation, confirm who currently holds a role, and map who sits where in a housing team. Research only — no connection requests, messages or InMail.

- Keep a short written profile of each organisation: what they do, what they've published, what they're likely to need

- Short confirmation calls to switchboards and reception to verify who holds a role, obtain a direct number, and book meetings into the director's diary

- Monitor UK procurement portals and published documents for relevant tenders and scheme updates



*Landlord and property outreach*



- Source suitable properties from listing sites, letting agents and landlord networks

- Contact landlords and agents by phone and email to introduce us and arrange viewings

- Book viewings into the director's diary with full details: address, access arrangements, contact name and number, asking rent, property type and condition

- Log every property and every conversation so we always know what's been approached, what's been ruled out, and why



*Coordination and admin*



- Own the follow-up schedule across both workstreams. Track every open thread, know what's due when, and prompt the director before a deadline passes, not after.

- Keep our CRM and Notion workspace up to date, so contact history, next actions and dates are always current

- Draft follow-up and confirmation emails for the director's review

- Build clean, readable decks and one-page summaries for meetings

- Bring us things we haven't asked for. Spotting a newly published scheme, a change of officer, or a well-priced property before we do is the most valuable thing you can do in this role.



**What we're looking for**



- You're good at digging. Give you an organisation's website with nothing but a switchboard number and you'll usually come back with a name and a direct line.

- Comfortable using LinkedIn search to find the right person by role and organisation

- Happy picking up the phone to UK landlords and letting agents. You can introduce us, answer the easy questions, and ask for a viewing without it feeling like a sales call.

- Good written English — enough that your draft emails need a light read rather than a rewrite

- Careful with detail. Names, numbers and dates are the whole job, so it matters that they're right.

- Organised by nature. You'll be running the follow-up schedule, and we'd rather it lived with you than with us.

- Familiar with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Excel) and Notion, or quick to pick them up

- Able to put together a tidy slide deck without much hand-holding

- Reliable internet, a quiet space to take calls, and a decent headset



**A note on AI**



Use AI where it helps — drafting, summarising long documents, tidying notes, getting a deck started. We'd rather you had it than not.



The only thing we'd ask is that you check what comes out of it. Contact details in particular can look convincing and be completely made up, so anything you pass to us should have been verified somewhere real first.



**Nice to have**



- Experience in real estate, property management or lettings

- Familiarity with the UK property, social housing or supported living sector

- Previous experience supporting a UK-based business



**Hours and terms**



4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, aligned to UK business hours. Preferred window 09:00–13:00 UK time (approximately 4pm–8pm Manila).



Paid one-month engagement to start, with a review at the end and the intention to continue with the right person long term.



We provide a UK landline number for all outbound calling, so you won't be paying international rates or calling from your own number.



**How to apply**



Send your CV along with the following. None of it needs to be long — we're mainly looking at how you go about things, not how much you write.



**1. Find the person.** Pick any council in the North West — Manchester, Liverpool, Preston, Stockport, wherever — and find the person responsible for private sector leasing or landlord liaison. Send us their name and job title.



**2. Find their email.** Same person. Tell us the email address and, briefly, how you worked it out.



**3. A short voice note.** Imagine you've called that council's main switchboard and someone has picked up. Record how you'd ask to be put through to the right team. Thirty seconds is plenty — this is just so we can hear how you sound on the phone. Please don't actually call anyone. (Please do not use Vocaroo as it does not work on our end)



**4. How you'd log it.** Tell us where you'd record what you found and what you'd write down, so that someone picking it up in three weeks knows exactly where things stand. If you've used a CRM before, tell us which. If you haven't, a spreadsheet or a Word document is a perfectly good answer — we're interested in how you think about keeping track, not the software.

The R3,500 trial compensation is based specifically on this 20-hour-per-week commitment.



During the trial period, you will work on real NORdee design projects, including custom apparel, graphics, branding and marketing material.



We will assess:



• Quality of your creative work

• Ability to interpret a brief

• Originality and creativity

• Speed and productivity

• Reliability

• Attention to detail

• Ability to work independently

• Communication and responsiveness

• Ability to handle feedback and revisions

• Technical design skills

• Ability to create designs that work on actual clothing

• Overall fit with the NORdee brand

________________________________________



Transition to Full-Time



If NORdee is happy with the quality of your work and both parties agree that the relationship is a good fit, the position will transition to a full-time independent contractor position.



Full-Time Position



Compensation: R10,000 per month



Working hours:



• Monday – Friday

• 09:00 – 17:00 South African time

• 40 hours per week



Location: Remote



Employment type: Independent Contractor



The full-time position will involve working closely with the NORdee team on an ongoing basis and taking responsibility for a significant portion of our creative and apparel design requirements.



The transition to the full-time position is subject to NORdee being satisfied with the candidate's performance during the trial period and both parties agreeing to continue.

________________________________________



Key Responsibilities



Apparel & Clothing Design



You will be responsible for creating original and commercially viable designs for:



• T-shirts

• Hoodies

• Padel shirts

• Sportswear

• Caps

• Visors

• Jackets

• Teamwear

• Clubwear

• Event clothing

• Corporate clothing

• Other customised apparel



You will take customer requirements and turn them into professional designs that can be manufactured.

Bespoke Design



A major part of the role will involve creating custom designs for clients.



For example, a customer may provide:



• A club logo

• Brand colours

• A rough idea

• A reference image

• A particular theme

• A basic design brief



You will be expected to turn this information into a professional, creative and original apparel concept.



We are looking for someone who can contribute creatively rather than simply follow instructions.



Graphic Design



You will also assist with:



• Logo design and development

• Branding

• Social media graphics

• Promotional artwork

• Marketing material

• Digital advertising

• Posters and event graphics

• Product graphics

• Typography

• Patterns and illustrations

• Presentation/mockup designs



Production-Ready Artwork



You must understand how to prepare designs for real-world production.



Experience with some or all of the following is highly beneficial:



• DTF printing

• Sublimation

• Screen printing

• Embroidery

• Vinyl

• Heat transfer

• Large-format printing



You should understand concepts such as:



• Vector artwork

• Resolution

• Bleed

• Colour profiles

• Pantone/brand colours

• Print sizing

• Artwork placement

• File formats

• Production specifications

________________________________________



Software & Design Platforms



You should be highly comfortable working across professional design platforms.

Experience with:



• Adobe Illustrator

• Adobe Photoshop

• Canva

• Figma

• CorelDRAW

• Other professional design software is beneficial.



You do not need to use every platform listed above, but you should be highly proficient in the tools you use and comfortable learning new platforms when required.

________________________________________



We are looking for someone who is:



Creative – You have strong visual taste and can develop ideas rather than simply execute instructions.



Commercially minded – You understand that designs must work on real products and appeal to paying customers.



Proactive – If you receive a brief, you think about how to make it better rather than simply doing exactly what was written.



Detail-oriented – Small mistakes in logos, typography, spacing, colours or artwork can affect the final product.



Fast and reliable – NORdee operates in a fast-moving environment, and we need someone who can meet deadlines and communicate clearly.



Open to feedback – Designs will often go through several revisions. You must be comfortable receiving feedback and improving your work.



Independent – As a remote contractor, you need to be able to manage your workload without constant supervision.

________________________________________



What We Expect From You



You should be able to take a brief such as:



"We need a premium padel shirt for a South African club. It needs to incorporate their logo and colours, but we want something modern, creative and different from a standard sports shirt."

…and turn that into a strong visual concept.



We don't want someone who simply places a logo onto a template.



We want someone who can say:



"Here are three creative directions I think would work."



That creative thinking is extremely important to this role.

________________________________________



Requirements



Essential



• Strong graphic design portfolio

• Demonstrable creative ability

• Experience designing for clothing/apparel

• Strong understanding of typography, composition and branding

• Ability to work with logos and brand guidelines

• Ability to create professional mockups

• Strong attention to detail

• Good English communication

• Ability to work independently

• Reliable internet connection

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–13:00 South African time during the trial

• Commitment to 20 hours per week during the trial



Highly Advantageous



• Apparel/fashion design experience

• Sportswear or teamwear experience

• Padel/tennis/sports design experience

• Printing/garment production knowledge

• Experience with embroidery artwork

• Experience with sublimation

• Experience creating repeat patterns

• Experience designing logos/brands from scratch

• Experience working with international clients

________________________________________



Portfolio



Your portfolio is extremely important to us.

Please provide examples of:



1. Clothing/apparel designs

2. Logo/branding work

3. Creative graphic design

4. Sportswear or teamwear if available

5. Any bespoke/custom projects

6. Mockups showing how your designs look on actual products



Please do not only send examples of Canva templates or basic social media posts.

We want to see your creativity and design thinking.

________________________________________



Trial Project



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small paid design test before the final selection.

The test will be based on a realistic NORdee apparel brief and will allow us to assess your:



• Creativity

• Design quality

• Ability to interpret a brief

• Apparel design ability

• Technical skills

• Attention to detail

________________________________________



Compensation

R3,500 for the month



This is based on:

• 20 hours per week

• Approximately 80 hours for the month

• Monday – Friday

• 09:00 – 13:00 South African time

• Independent contractor arrangement



This is a structured part-time trial and not an ad-hoc freelance arrangement.

Successful Completion of Trial

If NORdee is satisfied with your performance and both parties agree to continue:

R10,000 per month



Full-time independent contractor position:

• Monday – Friday

How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your CV or short professional profile

3. Examples specifically showing apparel/clothing design

• Adobe Illustrator

• Photoshop

If you are highly creative, love clothing and branding, and enjoy turning ideas into great-looking products, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Prompting Specialist — Viral Content (Part-Time → Full-Time Path)
description:

We run AI creator personas and need someone who can turn prompts into viral-ready photo and video content every single day.



The role:

You will generate AI photo and video content for our creator personas using our existing prompt engines and generation pipeline, including Kling, Seedance, kie.ai, and similar tools.



Your job is not just to generate content. Your job is to push every prompt until the output is strong enough to post, test, and scale.



When a piece of content starts performing, you need to recognize why it works and understand how to scale that exact viral format into more variations.



What we hire for:

Master-level AI prompting for image and video generation.



This is the one thing we do not compromise on.



If you can consistently produce high-quality, on-brand, scroll-stopping AI content from a prompt, you are in the right place.



What we will teach you:

Building and maintaining a distinct brand personality across creator accounts.

Reading
 
 mechanics, including hooks, shares, reactions, and format patterns.

Our internal pipeline, including n8n workflows, prompt engines, and quality control.



Experience in these areas is a plus, but not a requirement.



Schedule:

Daily commitment.

Minimum 4 hours per day.

Fully remote.

Starts part-time.

Serious applicants only.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test task before we start working together.

title: Roofing Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – U.S. Homeowners
description:
Everlast Roofing & Restoration is a Colorado roofing company looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to contact homeowners in areas affected by hail and severe weather and schedule qualified roof inspections for our sales team.

This is not a customer service position and it is not an inbound lead position. You will be making outbound calls to U.S. homeowners every day.



Your main job is simple: have real conversations, identify homeowners who may have storm damage, handle basic objections, and book qualified inspection appointments.

We provide the homeowner lists, dialing system, script/framework, training, and appointment calendar.

We are looking for someone who already understands cold calling and does not need to be convinced to pick up the phone.



What we care about most:

• Strong, clear spoken English

• Natural conversational delivery — not sounding like you are reading a script

• Previous cold calling or appointment-setting experience

• Experience calling U.S. homeowners strongly preferred

• Roofing, solar, insurance restoration, real estate, or home-services calling experience is a major plus

• Comfortable handling rejection and objections all day

• Reliable attendance and consistent calling activity

• Able to take coaching and quickly adjust their approach

• Accurate notes and appointment information

• Reliable internet, computer, headset, and quiet work environment



Performance will be measured primarily by qualified inspections booked, appointment quality, show rate, calling activity, and consistency.



This position can grow into a long-term role with increased responsibility and compensation for someone who performs.

Compensation: $6/hour + performance bonuses.



Schedule: 30–40 hours per week during U.S. Mountain Time calling hours.



TO APPLY:

Start your application with the word HAIL.



Then send:

-A short summary of your cold-calling experience, including what industries you called for.

-Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day in your most recent calling role.

-Your average appointments booked per day or week.

-Whether you have called U.S. homeowners before.

-A link to a 60–90 second voice recording.

-In the recording, first introduce yourself for about 20 seconds. Then read the following as naturally as possible:

“Hey John, this is Mia with Everlast Roofing & Restoration. I’m reaching out because we’ve been working with a few homeowners in your area after the recent hailstorms. I just wanted to see if anybody has taken a look at your roof yet for possible storm damage?”



Do not send an AI-generated voice recording.



Finally, briefly answer this question in your application:

A homeowner says, “I’m not interested. My roof is fine.” What would you say next?

Applications that do not include the voice recording and answers above will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Lead List Builder & Data Research VA – PropStream / DealMachine
description:
We are a growing roofing and restoration company in Colorado looking for a highly detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to build, clean, and maintain targeted homeowner lead lists for our outbound sales team.

This is NOT a cold calling position.



Your responsibility will be to make sure our cold callers are working from accurate, high-quality data instead of wasting time calling bad, duplicate, disconnected, or irrelevant numbers.

You will work primarily with PropStream and DealMachine to identify homeowners within specific geographic areas that we provide.



Responsibilities include:

• Building targeted homeowner lists using PropStream and DealMachine

• Searching specific neighborhoods, ZIP codes, addresses, and geographic target areas

• Identifying appropriate residential properties and property owners

• Skip tracing property owners to obtain contact information

• Cleaning and organizing raw lead data

• Removing duplicate records

• Identifying and removing obviously incorrect or unusable phone numbers

• Separating mobile, landline, and potentially invalid numbers when possible

• Cross-referencing records between multiple data sources

• Maintaining organized Google Sheets/CSV lead databases

• Tracking where each lead and phone number came from

• Preparing clean calling lists for a separate cold calling team



Accuracy is more important than simply producing a large number of records.

We recently tested outbound calling with lists where too many phone numbers were disconnected, invalid, or associated with the wrong person. The person hired for this position will be responsible for significantly improving the quality of the data before it ever reaches our callers.



Ideal candidate:

• Previous PropStream experience strongly preferred

• Previous DealMachine experience strongly preferred

• Experience with real estate lead generation or property research

• Experience with skip tracing and phone-number verification

• Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

• Extremely detail-oriented

• Understands deduplication and database cleanup

• Comfortable researching individual properties when information conflicts

• Able to follow detailed targeting criteria without adding irrelevant properties



Roofing experience is NOT required. Real estate/property-data experience is much more important.



Performance will be measured by:

• Percentage of records containing usable contact information

• Low duplicate rate

• Low wrong-number/disconnected-number rate

• Accuracy of property-owner information

• Ability to follow geographic/property targeting criteria

• Number of clean, call-ready records produced



When applying, please answer the following:



-How long have you used PropStream?

-How long have you used DealMachine?

-What skip-tracing tools have you used?



Describe how you would verify whether a phone number belongs to the correct property owner.

-If I gave you 1,000 raw property records, what steps would you take before handing the list to a cold caller?

-Approximately how many clean, verified homeowner records could you prepare in a 4-hour shift?



Please start your application with the words “CLEAN DATA” so I know you read the entire posting.

Candidates who perform well will have the opportunity for increased hours and long-term work.

title: Hail-Zone Outbound SDR / Roofing Appointment Setter
description:
Everlast Roofing & Restoration is looking for a confident, experienced outbound caller to help generate qualified roof inspections in Colorado hail-impacted areas.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. Your primary responsibility is simple: identify and contact homeowners in targeted hail zones, qualify potential roofing opportunities, and schedule legitimate roof inspections for our sales team.



We are looking for someone who understands that results matter. You will be measured on activity, conversations, appointments booked, and appointments that actually hold.



Responsibilities:



* Build and work targeted homeowner lists in Colorado hail-impacted areas

* Research, verify, and organize homeowner/property contact information

* Make high-volume outbound calls and follow-up attempts

* Speak confidently with homeowners about potential hail/storm damage

* Qualify homeowners before scheduling an inspection

* Handle common objections and continue conversations toward an appointment

* Schedule inspections directly onto our calendar

* Follow up with interested homeowners who are not ready to schedule immediately

* Maintain accurate notes and dispositions inside our CRM

* Track and report daily dials, contacts, conversations, bookings, and held appointments



A qualified appointment means the homeowner owns the property, is located within our target area, has a reasonable potential roofing or storm-damage need, agrees to a specific inspection date and time, and understands why our representative is coming to the property.



Requirements:



* Minimum 1 year of outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Previous experience calling U.S. customers strongly preferred

* Strong spoken English with clear and confident communication

* Comfortable making 100+ outbound attempts per day

* Experience handling objections and directly asking for appointments

* Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

* Ability to work U.S. Mountain Time hours

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer and quality headset

* Quiet professional workspace

* Experience using a CRM such as GoHighLevel or similar software

* Must be organized and consistent with follow-up

* Must be comfortable having performance tracked daily



We are especially interested in applicants with previous experience in roofing, solar, home services, insurance restoration, real estate, or other high-ticket appointment-setting environments.



Performance Expectations:



The goal of this position is to consistently generate qualified roof inspections for our sales team. We will track outbound attempts, contacts, qualified conversations, appointments booked, appointments held, and conversion rates.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes hours or tasks. We want someone who takes ownership of the numbers, recognizes when results are behind target, and adjusts their approach accordingly.



Application Requirements:



To be considered, begin your application with the word HAIL.



Your application must include:



* A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself

* Your previous outbound calling or appointment-setting experience

* The types of customers or industries you have called

* Your average number of outbound calls per day in previous roles

* Your best appointment-setting results or performance metrics

* Your experience handling objections

* Your availability to work U.S. Mountain Time

* A brief answer to this question: If you made 100 calls and booked zero appointments, what would you change before making the next 100?



Applications that do not include the requested information and voice recording will not be considered.



Compensation:



$5/hour plus $25 for each qualified inspection that is completed.



This role has room to grow for someone who consistently produces results and demonstrates strong ownership of their performance.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Us



We are looking for a full-time Video Editor for our YouTube channels:

• 

•

7. After approval, the video moves to Colour Grading and Sound Design

8. Final management approval.

9. Export and delivery.



Qualifications

• Your CV

• A showreel or 2–3 videos that best represent your work



Required Skills

- Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

- Basic to intermediate skills in Adobe After Effects

- Willingness to learn Geolayer3 map animations



Preferred Skills

- Experience with 2D or 3D animations

- Familiarity with organized Dropbox workflows.

title: Lead Generation Specialist — Full-Time (50% Partner Outreach / 50% Direct Business Outreach
description:
Lead Generation Specialist — Full-Time (50% Partner Outreach / 50% Direct Business Outreach)



**Company:** Profit Parrot (Home Services SEO Agency)

**Location:** Remote / Work From Home

**Schedule:** Full-Time



## About Us



I'm JM, founder of Profit Parrot, an SEO agency based in Ottawa, Canada. We help home service businesses — roofers, HVAC companies, plumbers, landscapers, and similar trades — get found online and get more customers.



## The Role



I'm hiring a Lead Generation Specialist to research and reach out to new business opportunities on our behalf, across cold email, LinkedIn, and influencer outreach. This is a hybrid research + outreach role — you'll find the right people and companies to contact, and then you'll be the one messaging them. Your work will be split into two parts:



### 1. Partner Outreach (50%)

You'll research and reach out to businesses that already work with home service companies and could refer clients to us — sign shops, branded apparel companies, and web developers. The goal is to build simple referral relationships where they send us leads and earn a commission.



### 2. Direct Business Outreach (50%)

You'll research and reach out directly to home service businesses in our target industries (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, and similar) using outreach templates and scripts we already have ready for you. The goal is to start conversations that lead to sales calls.



## What I'm Looking For



- Good written English — clear, simple, and professional

- Comfortable sending a high volume of outreach messages every day 
, LinkedIn, and influencer/creator outreach)

- Strong research skills — able to find the right contacts and companies to target

- Organized and reliable — you track your work and hit weekly targets

- Previous outreach, sales, or lead generation experience

- Access to tools you understand and that help with research and lead development



This is not a data-entry job. You will be researching real leads and talking to real people, starting real conversations that grow the business.



## How to Apply



If you're interested, please reply with:



1. A short summary of any outreach or sales experience you have

2. Your available hours per week

3. What tools you have for lead research and lead development

4. Your internet connection type

5. Your favourite way to generate leads and why

6. **What is the most challenging thing you've overcome with this role in the past, and how did you overcome it?**



Looking forward to hearing from you! When you reply, put the word "bacon" at the very start of your message. If you don't, your reply will not be considered.

title: Inside Sales Representative | Appointment Setter & Lead Follow-Up
description:
Full-Time | Remote | US Business Hours | Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for a confident, persuasive, and highly organized Inside Sales Representative to respond to inbound opportunities, follow up with leads, and convert qualified prospects into booked appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales role.



You will be responsible for responding quickly to new leads, speaking with customers about their pest-control needs, booking rodent and termite inspections, following up on unclosed opportunities, re-engaging previous estimates, and maintaining a disciplined sales pipeline.



We are looking for someone who combines excellent customer service with strong sales instincts, persistence, follow-through, and a measurable performance mindset.



You should be comfortable working toward clear targets and being held accountable for results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Inbound Sales

Respond quickly to new inbound leads and opportunities

Speak with prospective customers by phone, text, and email

Understand the customer's pest-control needs

Explain services and available options clearly

Build trust and rapport with potential customers

Convert qualified leads into booked inspections or appointments

Book rodent, termite, and other pest-control inspections

Handle basic objections and help customers move forward

Maintain a warm, professional, and persuasive communication style

Lead Follow-Up

Follow up consistently with leads who have not yet booked

Re-engage prospects who previously requested estimates

Follow up on open estimates and unclosed opportunities

Maintain structured follow-up sequences

Re-engage previous customers through win-back campaigns

Assist with referral campaigns and other outbound sales initiatives

Ensure leads do not fall through the cracks



Persistence is important in this role.



We are not looking for someone who follows up once and moves on.



CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records

Update lead status and next steps in the CRM

Keep detailed notes from customer conversations

Track follow-up dates and outstanding opportunities

Maintain a clean and organized sales pipeline

Ensure every active opportunity has a clear next action

Use the CRM consistently to maximize conversions and revenue

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Please apply only if you meet the following requirements:



Excellent spoken and written English

Strong, professional phone presence

Previous experience in inside sales, appointment setting, lead conversion, or customer service

Comfortable handling both inbound and outbound calls

Strong listening and communication skills

Ability to build rapport quickly

Comfortable handling objections and asking for the booking

Strong follow-up habits

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Comfortable using CRM software

Ability to follow a defined sales process

Ability to work independently

Reliable and consistent attendance

Comfortable being measured against KPIs and performance goals

Coachable and willing to improve based on feedback

Reliable computer, internet connection, and quiet workspace

IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who is:



Warm and personable

Persuasive without being pushy

Competitive

Persistent

Highly accountable

Process-driven

Results-oriented

Coachable

Emotionally intelligent

Trustworthy

Strong at listening

Comfortable asking questions

Excellent at following up

Motivated by hitting goals

Able to stay positive after rejection

Comfortable working in a structured sales environment



You should enjoy seeing your performance improve and understanding how your work contributes to company revenue.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This is a measurable sales position.



Performance may be evaluated using metrics such as:



Speed to lead

Number of leads contacted

Follow-up activity

Appointment or inspection booking rate

Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

Estimate follow-up

Re-engagement results

CRM accuracy

Sales pipeline activity

Revenue generated or influenced



You do not need to be perfect on day one.



You do need to be comfortable receiving feedback, reviewing your numbers, and continuously improving your performance.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience in any of the following is a strong advantage:



Inside sales

Phone sales

Appointment setting

Inbound lead conversion

Customer service

Home services

Pest control

HVAC

Plumbing

Roofing

Restoration

Landscaping

Cleaning services

Real estate

title: B2B Inside Sales Specialist – US Market | Cold Calling | Remote
description:
Location: Philippines – Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 4+ years in B2B Sales / Inside Sales / Business Development

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Equipment: Own laptop/desktop and reliable high-speed internet required



About the Company



We are a fast-growing US-focused company specializing in premium architectural hardware and custom-designed architectural products, including railings, Lucite/Acrylic products, iron door handles, and other architectural solutions.



We sell to customers and businesses in the US market and are looking for an experienced B2B Inside Sales Specialist who can help us build and grow our outbound sales pipeline.



This is a hands-on hunter sales role. We are looking for someone who enjoys finding new prospects, making cold calls, sending outbound emails, connecting with decision-makers, following up consistently, and closing B2B deals.



If you are someone who is comfortable spending a significant part of your day on the phone and actively generating new business, this role may be a strong fit.



What You Will Do

1. B2B Lead Generation & Prospecting

Research and identify potential B2B customers in the US market.

Build targeted prospect lists using online research, LinkedIn, company websites, directories, and other sources.

Identify decision-makers and key contacts within target companies.

Conduct daily outbound prospecting through:

Cold calls

Cold emails

LinkedIn outreach

Follow-up calls and messages

Maintain a consistent prospecting and follow-up cadence.

Generate qualified leads and sales opportunities.

2. Target Customers



You will primarily prospect and sell to businesses such as:



Architects

Interior Designers

General Contractors

Builders

Developers

Construction Companies

Procurement Teams

Hospitality Companies

Commercial Property Buyers

Other B2B customers involved in construction, architecture, renovation, and commercial projects



3. Sales & Closing

Manage prospects through the complete B2B sales cycle.

Qualify leads and understand customer requirements.

Present our architectural hardware and customized product solutions.

Prepare and discuss quotations and proposals.

Explain product specifications, pricing, availability, and delivery timelines.

Handle customer questions and objections.

Negotiate pricing and commercial terms.

Follow up with prospects until a decision is reached.

Close new B2B accounts and generate revenue.

Coordinate with internal teams after the sale to ensure smooth order execution.



4. CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate customer and prospect information in our CRM/ERP system.

Record calls, emails, meetings, opportunities, and follow-ups.

Keep the sales pipeline updated at all times.

Track lead generation and conversion activity.

Provide regular sales and pipeline reports.

Review results and continuously improve prospecting strategies.

What We Are Looking For

Must-Have Requirements

4+ years of B2B sales, inside sales, business development, or outbound sales experience.

Strong experience in cold calling and outbound prospecting.

Proven ability to generate new leads rather than relying only on inbound leads.

Experience managing prospects from lead generation → qualification → proposal → negotiation → closing.

Experience selling to businesses or decision-makers.

Strong spoken and written English.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

Strong follow-up discipline.

Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

Comfortable working with sales targets and KPIs.

Experience using a CRM to manage leads and opportunities.

Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Comfortable working US business hours.

Own laptop/desktop and reliable internet connection.



Preferred Experience



Experience selling to any of the following is highly preferred:



Architects

Interior designers

Contractors

Builders

Developers

Construction companies

Building material companies

Architectural products

Hardware

Premium fixtures

Hospitality businesses

Commercial buyers



Experience working with US-based customers is a strong advantage.



Experience with ERPNext / Frappe CRM is a plus, but is NOT mandatory. Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, GoHighLevel, or another structured CRM is acceptable.



Nice to Have



The following are advantages but are not mandatory:



Architectural hardware sales experience

Building materials sales experience

Construction product sales

Experience selling customized/premium products

Experience with RFQs, tenders, bidding, or proposal submissions

Existing relationships with architects, contractors, builders, developers, or procurement professionals

Experience selling into the US market

Experience working for a startup or e-commerce company

This Is a Hunter Sales Role



Please understand that this is not a passive account-management position.



A successful candidate should be comfortable with:



Making cold calls every day

Speaking with new prospects

Finding new businesses to target

Building prospect lists from scratch

Sending outbound emails

LinkedIn prospecting

Following up multiple times

Handling objections

Booking sales conversations

Preparing quotations/proposals

Negotiating with customers

Closing deals

Working toward sales targets

Maintaining an active sales pipeline



You should enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for leads to come to you.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who can say:



"Give me a target market, a product, and a list of potential customers. I can research the right companies, find the decision-makers, reach out to them, qualify the opportunity, follow up consistently, and work toward closing the deal."



We are looking for someone who is proactive, persistent, commercially minded, organized, and comfortable with rejection.



Working Hours



9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST



This is approximately 9:30 PM – 5:30 AM Philippines Time, depending on US daylight-saving time.



You must be comfortable working the required US schedule consistently.



Equipment Requirements



You must have:



Your own reliable laptop or desktop computer

Stable, high-speed internet connection

A quiet environment suitable for making business calls

Headset/microphone suitable for professional calls

What We Offer

Fully remote work

Full-time position

Competitive compensation based on experience

Commission on closed revenue

US market exposure

Direct exposure to the founder and leadership team

Opportunity to help build the B2B sales function from the ground up

Long-term growth opportunities as the company expands

Mandatory Assessment – Required to Apply



Please read this section carefully.



Before applying, you are required to complete our mandatory sales assessment.



Assessment: 
/document/d/1wne0kqDYNE2zqUOGhPeqnWDPFg4lek3lIwe1f8vLYNI/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.vaoryw2vgiyq



Complete the Mandatory Sales Assessment



Application Requirements



To be considered, please submit:



Your updated CV/resume

Your completed assessment

A brief summary of your B2B sales experience

Your experience with cold calling/outbound sales

The types of products/services you have sold

Whether you have experience selling to US customers

Your experience with CRM systems

Confirmation that you can work 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Confirmation that you have your own laptop and reliable internet



Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.



Please apply only if you have genuine B2B/outbound sales experience and are comfortable with a high-activity cold-calling environment.



We are looking for someone who can build a pipeline, create opportunities, develop relationships, and close B2B business.

title: Creative Strategist Native Ads
description:
EVOLVE Digital is a performance marketing and e-commerce agency based in Germany, working with a fully remote, international team. Native Ads is a dedicated growth channel for us — not a leftover-budget channel. The bottleneck isn't the account, it's creative supply. That's exactly what you'll solve.



What you'll do

Develop angles based on audience research, buying motives, psychological triggers, and competitor analysis on Taboola and Outbrain

Concept AND produce image creatives yourself — in variants and at high speed (this is not a briefing-only role)

Use AI image tools deliberately to generate motifs, variants, and crops fast

Plan creative tests along clear variables (image motif, crop, headline, hook) and evaluate them together with media buying

Think through the full path from the ad through advertorial and pre-lander to the offer page

Spot winners and roll them out across other accounts

Maintain the creative database and documentation (ClickUp, Miro) so results are traceable



What you bring

A portfolio of image creatives you conceived AND built yourself for paid e-commerce campaigns — concept and execution in one person, not a pure briefing role

Confident use of creative metrics (CTR, CPC, conversion rate, ROAS) as the basis for decisions, not taste

Active, concrete use of AI tools in your own image production

Taboola and Outbrain experience is a plus — alternatively, strong direct-response craft from Meta or Google with a willingness to learn native

Understanding of direct-response and funnel logic (advertorial, pre-lander, offer page)

E-commerce/D2C background, not purely B2B or lead-gen

Structured, self-directed way of working remotely and part-time, without outside oversight



What we offer

Start part-time at ~20 hrs/week, with the potential to grow into full-time

Fully remote

A dedicated Creative Team with a direct interface to Native media buying, copywriting, and design

Those who help build the channel take on more accounts, more budget responsibility, and technical oversight of creative suppliers over time

title: Media Buyer Native Ads
description:
EVOLVE Digital is a performance marketing and e-commerce agency based in Germany (Osnabrück), working with a fully remote, international team. We're looking for an experienced media buyer with a strong track record in scaling native ad accounts.



What you'll do

Independently manage our Taboola and Outbrain campaigns according to existing SOPs

Handle daily budget, bid, publisher, and placement management, including blocklist maintenance

Make data-driven scaling decisions — knowing when an account can handle more budget without hurting margin

Build and run systematic testing on angles, creatives, thumbnails, and offer pages

Analyze performance by device, time of day, placement, and publisher, and translate findings into action

Brief copywriting and design based on data and a clear hypothesis

Document tests, decisions, and results clearly enough for another buyer to take over



What you bring

Proven track record of scaling native ad accounts from five- to six-figure monthly budgets

Several years of consistent, hands-on experience specifically with Taboola and/or Outbrain

E-commerce/D2C experience

Solid understanding of tracking/attribution and direct-response funnels (advertorial, pre-lander, offer page)

Disciplined, self-directed work following SOPs, with minimal oversight

Fluent English, spoken and written



What we offer

Freelance role starting at ~20 hrs/week, with potential to grow into full-time

Fully remote, reliable availability within an agreed time window across time zones

No direct client contact — full focus on execution, testing, and scaling



To apply: Please send your CV/portfolio with concrete budget figures from accounts you've managed, and briefly answer:



Describe an account you scaled from a lower to a significantly higher monthly budget. How did it unfold, and what did you specifically change when performance started to tip?

Which platforms have you independently managed native ads on — Taboola, Outbrain, or both — and for how long? Give approximate budget sizes per account.

Tell us about a case where a campaign stagnated or crashed. How did you figure out whether the issue was the angle, creative, placement, or tracking?

title: Freelance AI Webtoon Typesetter
description:
We are looking for freelance webtoon typesetters to review and refine AI-generated multilingual webtoon typesetting.



Most of the initial typesetting is already completed by our AI system. Your role is mainly to review the generated result and make any necessary adjustments in Photoshop, such as text placement, sizing, spacing, and overall visual balance.



Because the AI handles most of the initial work, the editing workload is very light. One episode can typically be completed in less than 1 hour, depending on the episode and the amount of correction needed.



Please note that projects may involve 17+ content, so applicants must be comfortable working with such materials as part of the production process.



Responsibilities:

- Edit AI-generated webtoon typesetting in Adobe Photoshop

- Compare the target-language typesetting with the English source webtoon

- Adjust text placement, line breaks, size, spacing, and alignment for readability and visual balance

- Avoid covering important artwork, character faces, expressions, or other key visual elements unnecessarily

- Maintain consistent text sizing, placement, and overall presentation throughout each episode

- Follow provided typesetting guidelines and manager feedback accurately



Requirements:

- Adobe Photoshop is required

- Experience with Photoshop text editing and layer-based PSD workflows

- Strong attention to detail and visual balance

- Ability to follow provided references and production guidelines accurately

- Good English communication skills

- Reliable delivery and ability to work independently

- Comfortable working with 17+ webtoon content



Preferred (Optional):

- Previous experience with webtoon, manga, comic, or localization typesetting

- Experience working with multilingual content

- Familiarity with speech bubbles, SFX, narration, and dialogue layout

- Experience handling layered PSD files



Work Details:

- Freelance / Remote

- Flexible working hours

- Long-term collaboration available

- English source webtoons, AI-generated target-language versions, PSD files, and detailed production guidelines will be provided

- Work is completed in Photoshop and submitted according to the project workflow



Payment:

- $3 per completed episode



Selected applicants will be asked to complete a short unpaid typesetting test before final onboarding.

 ads, a keen eye for detail, focused on ROI and the ability to think strategically. Ideally you will have experience running a range of low to high budget CPA based campaigns for businesses on the agency side.

Your skills:
