The Dilate Digital Team

title: Recruitment Delivery and Talent Manager
description:
Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating exclusively across the UK accountancy profession.



We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment business, and we are looking for an exceptional Recruitment Delivery and Talent Manager to take ownership of candidate delivery and help build the high-performance talent function required to support that growth.



This is a hands-on recruitment-delivery position. You will personally identify, approach, engage and qualify high-quality candidates while taking responsibility for ensuring that priority vacancies receive consistent and effective candidate coverage.



The title “Manager” reflects the level of ownership, judgement and accountability required. It is not initially a people-management position. You will be expected to manage candidate pipelines, vacancy coverage, delivery standards, priorities, follow-up and your own performance at an exceptionally high level.



This is not an administrative resourcing role, and it is not suitable for someone who waits to receive a daily list of instructions. We need an intelligent, resilient and commercially aware individual who takes ownership, maintains momentum and makes things happen.



The purpose of the role



You will work closely with the founder of the business, who has more than 20 years’ experience recruiting exclusively within the UK accountancy-practice market.



Your responsibility will be to build and maintain a consistent pipeline of high-quality candidates, qualify them properly and progress them through the recruitment process.



You will undertake the detailed research, sourcing, engagement, qualification and follow-up required before involving the founder at the most commercially important stages.



The objective is not simply to generate names, searches, messages or activity. It is to create genuine candidate conversations, submissions, interviews, offers, successful appointments and long-term relationships.



You will remain responsible for each candidate, vacancy and agreed action until the required outcome has been achieved, accurately recorded and clearly communicated.



Key responsibilities



Candidate sourcing and market mapping



* Proactively identify high-quality accountancy professionals for current and future recruitment opportunities.

* Build detailed talent pools across specific locations, accountancy disciplines and levels of seniority.

* Research candidates thoroughly before making contact.

* Use LinkedIn, recruitment databases, online research, referrals, email, telephone and other appropriate channels.

* Develop effective search strategies rather than relying on obvious job titles or basic keyword searches.

* Map relevant candidates working within national, regional, independent and private-equity-backed accountancy firms.

* Identify candidate movement patterns between different types and sizes of firm.

* Maintain long-term pipelines in areas where suitable candidates are particularly difficult to find.

* Continually expand the business’s understanding of the available candidate market.



Candidate engagement



* Produce persuasive and highly personalised candidate approaches.

* Communicate confidently and professionally with UK accountancy professionals at different levels of seniority.

* Generate genuine interest rather than simply sending high volumes of generic messages.

* Follow up intelligently, consistently and persistently.

* Remain positive and productive when initial approaches receive no response or are rejected.

* Re-engage candidates who may previously have been unavailable or unwilling to consider a move.

* Build trusted relationships with candidates who may not be ready to move immediately.

* Ask candidates for appropriate introductions and referrals.

* Ensure that every worthwhile candidate relationship has a clear and dated next action.



Candidate qualification



* Conduct detailed initial conversations with prospective candidates.

* Establish their current role, responsibilities, technical experience and level of seniority.

* Understand their qualifications, study status and professional development.

* Explore the size and complexity of any client portfolio they manage.

* Establish their client-facing, review, supervisory and team-management responsibilities.

* Understand why they may consider moving and determine the strength of that motivation.

* Record their current salary, expectations, notice period and availability.

* Establish their preferred locations, realistic commuting area and working-arrangement expectations.

* Understand the type, size, culture and ownership structure of firm that would suit them.

* Identify other interviews, applications or recruitment processes already underway.

* Assess counteroffer, withdrawal and non-commencement risks.

* Obtain a current CV and all relevant information before arranging a conversation with the founder.

* Avoid progressing applicants who are unsuitable, weakly motivated or insufficiently qualified.



Vacancy delivery and prioritisation



* Develop a thorough understanding of every priority vacancy.

* Review and prioritise vacancies according to urgency, commercial value and likelihood of success.

* Create a clear candidate-sourcing and engagement plan for each priority assignment.

* Build sufficiently broad pipelines rather than relying on one or two possible candidates.

* Monitor candidate coverage and identify gaps before momentum is lost.

* Maintain a clear, dated next action against every active candidate and vacancy.

* Recognise when a search, message or target market is not producing the required results.

* Diagnose whether problems arise from targeting, candidate availability, outreach, qualification or the vacancy itself.

* Recommend practical corrective action rather than simply reporting that a search is difficult.

* Escalate genuine obstacles promptly, supported by evidence and a recommended solution.

* Ensure that no viable candidate or commercially important vacancy becomes inactive through inadequate follow-up.



Candidate presentation and recruitment-process management



* Match candidates intelligently to suitable vacancies, firms and working environments.

* Prepare accurate and persuasive candidate summaries.

* Ensure that candidates understand opportunities before their details are presented.

* Arrange candidate meetings and interviews efficiently.

* Provide complete and accurate information to everyone involved.

* Prepare candidates thoroughly for interviews.

* Obtain detailed feedback promptly after interviews.

* Progress next steps without avoidable delay.

* Maintain candidate engagement through multiple interview stages.

* Support candidates through offer, resignation and notice-period stages.

* Identify and manage the risk of counteroffers, withdrawals and failed commencements.

* Maintain appropriate alternative candidates until an appointment is secure.

* Continue communicating with placed candidates until they have commenced successfully.



Delivery performance and continuous improvement



* Monitor personal sourcing, engagement and conversion performance.

* Understand where candidates are being lost within the recruitment process.

* Review the effectiveness of searches, messages, follow-up and qualification.

* Test and improve sourcing strategies and candidate approaches.

* Identify patterns in successful and unsuccessful activity.

* Maintain accurate pipeline information and delivery forecasts.

* Provide concise progress updates supported by evidence.

* Critique your own performance honestly and identify specific improvements.

* Help develop consistent delivery standards and processes as the business grows.

* Share observations, ideas and recommended actions rather than waiting to be asked.

* Maintain both pace and quality without allowing either to become an excuse for weakness in the other.



CRM and information management



* Maintain complete and accurate candidate records within the CRM.

* Record all material conversations, messages, motivations, preferences and agreed actions.

* Ensure that notes are sufficiently detailed for another person to understand precisely what has happened and what should happen next.

* Maintain accurate vacancy, interview, offer and placement activity.

* Protect confidential candidate and client information.

* Follow all business procedures relating to data protection, systems and AI use.

* Ensure that every completed action is properly recorded and communicated.



The reality of successful recruitment delivery



Successful recruitment delivery requires intelligence, judgement and strong communication. It also requires the discipline to repeat essential activities consistently.



Researching, searching, approaching, following up, updating records and reviewing pipelines must be completed every working day. Some candidates will not respond. Others will decline opportunities, withdraw or change their minds.



The successful person must be able to maintain pace, accuracy, attention to detail and a positive attitude even when work becomes repetitive or results are not immediate.



Starting a task is not the same as completing it. Sending one message is not effective follow-up. Identifying one candidate is not adequate vacancy coverage. Reporting a difficulty is not the same as recommending and implementing a solution.



We need someone who remains personally responsible for moving work towards the required outcome.



The person we are looking for



The successful applicant will be:



* **Exceptionally proactive:** You act without waiting to be repeatedly instructed.

* **Tenacious:** You remain focused through rejection, non-response and setbacks.

* **Consistent:** You maintain strong standards every day, including when work is repetitive.

* **Accountable:** You accept personal responsibility for your commitments and results.

* **Completion-focused:** You follow work through to its proper conclusion.

* **Commercially aware:** You understand how candidate activity contributes to interviews, placements and revenue.

* **Resourceful:** You can take limited information, research it and determine the best next action.

* **Independent:** You can organise and progress your work without constant supervision.

* **Analytical:** You can identify patterns, diagnose problems and improve your approach.

* **Self-critical:** You review your own work honestly and continually seek improvement.

* **Quality-conscious:** You pursue the highest practical standard while maintaining appropriate pace.

* **Positive and resilient:** You remain constructive and productive when results take time.

* **Highly organised:** You can manage numerous candidates, vacancies, deadlines and follow-ups without losing control.

* **An exceptional communicator:** Your spoken and written English is of an outstanding professional standard.

* **Dependable:** If you commit to an action, it will be completed properly and on time.

* **Adaptable:** You respond constructively to changing priorities within a growing entrepreneurial business.



Essential requirements



* Educated to degree level or able to demonstrate equivalent intellectual and professional capability.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Substantial experience in recruitment delivery, candidate sourcing, executive search or talent acquisition.

* Evidence of personally building and maintaining candidate pipelines.

* Experience conducting candidate screening or qualification conversations.

* Evidence of progressing candidates through recruitment processes.

* Strong online research and talent-mapping capability.

* Confidence communicating with experienced UK professionals.

* Ability to create persuasive, personalised candidate outreach.

* Experience using a CRM, applicant-tracking system or comparable database.

* Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping.

* Demonstrable experience of working independently.

* Evidence of taking ownership and completing work without being chased.

* Ability to sustain consistent activity and standards over time.

* Reliable computer equipment, high-speed internet and a professional home-working environment.

* Availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday.



Experience recruiting within accountancy, financial services or another professional-services market would be advantageous but is not essential.



Performance measures



Success will be assessed through measurable delivery outcomes, including:



* Relevant candidates identified and engaged.

* Meaningful candidate conversations completed.

* Fully qualified candidate meetings booked and attended.

* Current CVs and complete candidate information obtained.

* Suitable candidate submissions made.

* Submission-to-interview conversion.

* Interview-to-offer conversion.

* Offer acceptance and successful commencement rates.

* Candidate pipelines developed and maintained.

* Priority-vacancy coverage.

* Candidate relationships reactivated.

* Candidate referrals generated.

* Speed, quality and consistency of follow-up.

* Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.

* Reliability of pipeline information and forecasts.

* Completion of agreed actions without reminders.

* Evidence of independent judgement and continuous improvement.



Activity matters, but activity without quality, progression or outcomes will not be regarded as success.



Supporting the founder and wider business



You will become a highly dependable extension of the founder and protect his time by ensuring that research, initial engagement and qualification have been completed properly before involving him.



You will:



* Provide concise and commercially useful candidate information.

* Prepare the founder thoroughly for candidate conversations.

* Arrange worthwhile candidate meetings directly into his diary.

* Complete agreed follow-up actions promptly.

* Anticipate what should happen next.

* Raise problems early and provide a recommended solution.

* Create certainty through accurate information, attention to detail and dependable execution.



As the delivery function grows, there may be scope to help establish processes, share best practice and support the development of additional delivery resources. The immediate priority, however, is outstanding personal delivery rather than people management.



 What this role is not



This is not a general virtual-assistant, data-entry or administrative position.



It is not suitable for someone who:



* Needs every task broken down into detailed instructions.

* Waits to be told what to do next.

* Loses motivation when work becomes repetitive.

* Sends one message and considers the task complete.

* Allows candidates or actions to disappear through inadequate follow-up.

* Reports problems without attempting to understand or resolve them.

* Measures contribution purely by hours worked or tasks started.

* Avoids personal accountability when results fall below expectations.



We are looking for somebody who continually asks:



**“What outcome is required, what should happen next, and what can I do now to move this forward?”**



What we offer



* An hourly rate of US$15–$25, depending on experience and capability.

* A full-time, long-term opportunity.

* Close working contact with a recruitment business founder who has more than 20 years of specialist experience.

* Detailed training in the UK accountancy-practice market.

* Access to professional recruitment, research and AI systems.

* The opportunity to take genuine ownership of an important business function.

* Considerable scope for the role to develop as the business grows.

* The opportunity to contribute to the development of a substantial specialist recruitment company.



Engagement details



This is a full-time, self-employed independent-contractor opportunity. The successful applicant will not be employed directly by Garry Howling Recruitment and will be responsible for managing and paying their own tax, statutory contributions, insurance and any other obligations arising in their country of residence.



The contractor must provide suitable computer equipment, a reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional home-working environment.



The role requires availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Local working hours will change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.



Although this is an independent-contractor engagement, we are looking for someone who wants to work closely with the founder and wider team and make a significant, long-term contribution to Garry Howling Recruitment.



Application process



The selection process is expected to include:



1. CV or résumé submission and initial application review.

2. Shortlisting of selected applicants.

3. A recorded video answering five defined questions.

4. Initial interview.

5. Practical recruitment-delivery assessment.

6. Final interview.

7. Independent-contractor offer.



The recorded-video stage will assess communication, consistency, tenacity, ownership, resilience and self-awareness.



Applicants who progress may also be asked to demonstrate:



* Research and market-mapping capability.

* Written and spoken communication.

* Candidate identification and engagement.

* Candidate qualification.

* Commercial judgement.

* Personal ownership and follow-through.

* Ability to critique and improve their own work.

* Confidence conducting a simulated candidate conversation.

* Ability to produce accurate and detailed written records.



All information and work submitted during the application process must be the applicant’s own and must accurately represent their experience and capabilities.

title: Recruitment & Team Building Specialist
description:
ABOUT BEES MOBILE



Bees Mobile is a digital communications company providing US/HK virtual phone numbers and travel eSIM services.



We are now expanding in the Philippines and looking for team members who can help us recruit, train, and grow our local Partner Network.



This is a long-term opportunity, starting with a short paid trial.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your main job is to find and recruit people who can become Bees Mobile Partners and Team Leaders, then help them get started and grow their teams.



Your responsibilities include:



Recruit Partners and potential Team Leaders across the Philippines

Reach out through
, Messenger, online communities, and your own network

Conduct online presentations through Zoom, Messenger, or similar platforms

Onboard and train new Partners using materials provided by the company

Follow up with Partners and help keep them active

Track recruitment results and submit a simple weekly report

Share feedback with our Marketing Team about what works in the Philippine market

title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly analytical, sharp, and proactive Creative Strategist for Meta Ads.



To be incredibly clear: This is NOT a graphic design or video editing role. You will not be pushing pixels in Figma or editing timelines in Premiere.



You are the architect of our ad account. Your job is to conduct deep market research, understand consumer psychology, develop high-converting direct response (DR) angles, and write airtight creative briefs for our design and editing teams. You must understand why people buy and know how to structure a scroll-stopping hook and a persuasive script that sells.



If you are someone who waits to be handed a list of ideas to brief, or if you just guess what might look "cool" without looking at the data, this is not the role for you. We need a strategic powerhouse who owns the creative testing roadmap from insight to execution to analysis.



Core Responsibilities

- Deep Avatar & Market Research: Obsessively research our target demographic. You will scour competitor ad libraries, mine customer reviews, read Reddit threads, and analyze TikTok comments to uncover hidden pain points and desires.  

- Angle & Concept Ideation: Develop original, direct response advertising angles. You will translate your research into structured concepts (e.g., problem/solution, Us vs. Them, scientific proof/temperature control comparisons, emotional triggers). 

- Airtight Creative Briefing: Write highly detailed, idiot-proof creative briefs and video scripts for our designers and editors. Your briefs must clearly define the hook, the visual layout, the on-screen text, the pacing, and the core CTA.  

- Creative Performance Analysis: You won't just launch briefs and forget them. You will actively analyze performance data in Meta Ads Manager and our attribution software (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale) to diagnose hook rates, thumb-stop ratios, and CPA. You must be able to explain why an ad won or lost.  

- Testing Roadmap Management: Build and manage our weekly creative testing pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of fresh concepts, iterative variations of winning ads, and new format tests.  



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Direct Response Mastery is Mandatory: You must have a deep, proven understanding of what makes a Meta ad convert. You know the anatomy of a winning ad, consumer psychology, and how to structure a pitch that drives immediate action.

- Exceptional Copywriting & Scripting: Flawless written English. You must be able to write punchy, persuasive video scripts, ad copy, and headlines that resonate with a US-based consumer.

- Data Literacy: You must be comfortable reading data. You know the difference between a creative problem (low hook rate) and a landing page problem (high CTR, low CVR), and you use that data to guide your next brief.

- Proactive & Independent: You do not need to be micromanaged. You independently spot fatigue in our ad account, research what competitors are scaling, and pitch your own concepts.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

- Prior experience strategizing for sleep-tech, health/wellness, or high-AOV premium home goods brands.

- Familiarity with creative research and saving tools like Foreplay or Atria.



How to Apply:

If you are sharp, obsessed with consumer psychology, and ready to be the brains behind our Meta ad engine, please reply with:

- A link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder containing 2–3 examples of creative briefs or scripts you have written that resulted in profitable ads, and the images/videos of those ads (if available).

You get US healthcare candidates on the PHONE, screen them properly, verify their credentials, write a submit-ready candidate packet, and book the submission with our US team. All candidates you recruit are US-based clinicians (radiologic technologists, CT/MRI techs, sonographers, surgical techs, respiratory therapists, physicians); all clients are US hospitals and health systems. This is a senior seat with a real quota and real commission: you own the screened-submission number for your desk, starting at 5 screened submissions/week and ramping to 10. Every placement you make pays you a commission on top of base.



WHAT YOU DO DAILY:

- Work the AI-generated worklist: call US imaging/allied and physician candidates (we provide the phone system; allied-health candidates prefer phone — that's why this is a voice seat).

- Run a structured recruiter screen: motivation, compensation expectations, licensure, timeline, fit against the live req.

- Write a tight, submit-ready candidate packet (summary, credentials, comp, availability, why-this-req) and book the client submission with the US team.

- Keep the ATS honest: every call, every disposition, same day.



REQUIRED:

title: AI AUTOMATION & AI CLONE ENGINEER SSS and Retirement
description:
AI AUTOMATION & AI CLONE ENGINEER

Full-Time Remote — Philippines



 $1,250–$2,000 USD/Month + Bonuses + Benefits + Technology Allowance



We are looking for **one exceptional AI builder** to join our team full-time and, ideally, stay with us for years.



**This is NOT a virtual assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who lives and breathes AI, automation, agents and emerging technology.



If you're constantly experimenting with new AI tools, building automations, figuring out how to make AI do work that normally requires people, and learning what's coming next — we want to talk to you.



## WE ARE LOOKING FOR A LONG-TERM TEAM MEMBER



This isn't a 3-month project.



We have **plenty of work today and a growing pipeline of AI projects for the future.**



We want to find someone exceptional, invest in them, give them great technology to work with, and build a relationship that can last **years and years.**



As our capabilities and client base grow, we want this person's responsibilities, skills and compensation to grow with us.



## YOUR FIRST MAJOR PROJECT: BUILD A COMPLETE AI CLONE



Your first major project will be helping us build a **complete, production-ready AI clone of our founder.**



Not simply a short AI-generated video.



We want a reusable system capable of generating convincing videos using his:



**Voice

Face and appearance

Speech

Lip synchronization

Natural movement

Presentation style**



Once built, we should be able to provide a newscript and generate professional AI videos without repeatedly recording the real person.



This isn't just an experiment.



We already have **5–6 clients ready for AI cloning**, and we expect this service to grow.



Your job will be to help us perfect the process and then make it repeatable for clients.



## AI CLONING IS ONLY PART OF THE JOB



We're building an AI automation company.



You'll also help create:



**AI agents

AI workflows

Business-process automations

24/7 AI workers

CRM automations

Lead-generation systems

Sales and marketing automations

Client onboarding systems

API integrations

Voice AI

AI video systems

Internal business automations**



We want someone who can look at a business problem and ask:



### "How can AI automate this?"



And then actually build it.



## TECHNOLOGY & EXPERIENCE



You don't need to know every tool below.



You DO need to be highly capable with several of them and able to learn new technology extremely quickly.



Experience with:



**OpenAI / OpenAI API

Claude / Anthropic

Gemini

OpenClaw

Hermes or comparable agent frameworks

n8n

Make

Zapier

APIs and webhooks

JSON

Python and/or JavaScript

AI agents

LLM workflows

Voice AI and voice cloning

AI avatars and video cloning

CRM automation**



Experience with ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Synthesia, Tavus, Captions or similar technologies is valuable.



**We care much more about what you've actually built than your degree or certificates.**



## COMPENSATION



### $1,250–$2,000 USD PER MONTH



Starting compensation will depend on demonstrated skill, experience and the quality of your work.



This is a **full-time, long-term position.**



In addition to base compensation, there are opportunities for **performance and project bonuses** as we successfully deploy systems for clients.



Exceptional people who create exceptional value will have opportunities to increase their compensation and responsibilities.



## BENEFITS & LONG-TERM INVESTMENT



We want someone who sees this as a **career opportunity**, not another short-term online job.



After successfully completing the probationary period, eligible team members will receive company-supported Philippine benefits, including:



**PhilHealth health coverage/contributions**



**SSS retirement/social-security contributions**



Additional benefit details, eligibility and company/employee contribution arrangements will be explained during the hiring process and structured in accordance with the applicable employment arrangement and Philippine requirements.



### UP TO $2,000 USD HIGH-PERFORMANCE LAPTOP



We also believe AI professionals need serious equipment.



After successfully completing your **first year with the company**, we will provide or fund an **ultra-high-performance laptop valued at up to $2,000 USD** for eligible full-time employees.



And this isn't intended to be a one-time benefit.



For employees who remain with the company and continue performing at a high level, we intend to provide a **technology refresh allowance of up to $2,000 after each subsequent completed year**, subject to company policy and equipment needs.



We want our AI team working with **excellent technology — not fighting outdated computers.**



## STABILITY



One of the biggest things we can offer the right person is **work.**



We aren't hiring because we have one project that needs to be completed.



We already have AI projects underway, clients waiting, automations to build, cloning projects to complete and considerably more coming.



### We have enough work to keep the right person busy for years.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us as AI changes — and potentially become one of the key technical people in our company.



## PAID FINALIST CHALLENGE



We don't want to hire someone simply because they interview well.



**We want to see what you can actually build.**



Selected finalists will be offered a:



### $75 USD PAID AI CLONING CHALLENGE



We will provide approved source video and audio of our founder.



Your assignment will be to create a **usable AI video + voice clone system** within the agreed scope.



We're not looking for a 15-second trick or filter.



We're evaluating whether you understand how to create a **repeatable AI cloning system capable of producing new content.**



You choose the technology.



Be prepared to explain:



**What tools you selected and why

How the system works

What it costs to operate

Approximate cost per finished minute

How you would automate it

How you would improve quality

How you would reproduce the system for our clients**



Any third-party costs required for the challenge must be disclosed and approved before starting.



## HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



### "I BUILD AI."



Then answer:



**1. Show us the 3 most impressive AI automations or agents you've personally built.**



**2. Have you created a realistic AI video or voice clone? Show us examples you are permitted to share.**



**3. What have you actually built using OpenClaw, Hermes or comparable autonomous-agent technology?**



**4. What's the most complicated n8n, Make, API or automation workflow you've built?**



**5. If we gave you high-quality video and audio of someone, what technology stack would you investigate first to create a reusable video + voice clone, and why?**



**6. How would you minimize the ongoing cost of producing videos once the clone is built?**



**7. What's something involving AI you taught yourself in the last 90 days?**



**8. What monthly salary are you seeking in USD?**



**9. Are you available full-time and looking for a long-term position?**



Finally, put:



### DOMINATE



at the very end of your application.



You are welcome to use AI to help prepare your application.



**We're an AI company. We'd be surprised if you didn't.**



But don't let AI invent your experience.



If you say you built something, be prepared to **show it, explain it and demonstrate it.**



We're not looking for someone to complete a project and disappear.



### We're looking for someone we can invest in, keep busy, develop and work with for years.



If you're an AI builder looking for that kind of opportunity, **we want to hear from you.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor - TikTok, Reels & YouTube Shorts
description:
About the Role



Jim Penman is best known as the founder of Jim's Group.

This role focuses on Jim's personal brand, academic research, and upcoming book, Birth Rate Crisis.



His content covers topics including:

- Global fertility decline

- Epigenetics

- Dopamine sensitivity

- Mental health

- Family formation

- Human behaviour

- The rise and decline of civilizations

- Biohistory



The challenge is simple.



Take complex scientific and historical ideas and turn them into short videos that everyday people want to watch, share and debate.



What You'll Do

You will work with long-form podcasts, interviews and lectures.



Your job is to:

- Find the strongest moments without being given timestamps

- Identify hooks that can stop someone scrolling

- Turn long conversations into 45-90 second videos

- Edit for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

- Add dynamic captions

- Add relevant B-roll and visual aids

- Use charts, graphics and images where they improve understanding

- Remove unnecessary pauses and sections

- Keep complex ideas understandable without changing their meaning



This is not simply a video-cutting role.



You need to understand what Jim is saying and identify what will interest an audience.



What We're Looking For



Short-form experience

You have edited TikToks, Reels or YouTube Shorts from long-form content.

Strong editorial judgement

You can watch a long interview and find the 60 seconds most likely to generate discussion.

Retention-focused editing



You understand hooks, pacing, captions, pattern changes and viewer retention.

Software skills

You can use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or similar software.

Interest in complex subjects

You are comfortable editing discussions about science, psychology, history and society.

You do not need to be an academic. You do need to understand the material before editing it.



How To Apply



Please include:

1. A link to examples of your recent short-form video work.

2. Your preferred editing software.

3. Your expected hourly or monthly rate.

4. Your normal turnaround time for one 45-90 second video.

5. Pick one video from your portfolio. In 2-3 sentences, explain why you think the edit works.

title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

title: GoHighLevel Operations & Business Assistant
description:
About the role



I run a membership community for clinic owners — chiropractors, physios, massage therapists — across the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and the USA. The business is growing and I need a reliable right-hand person to handle the operational side so I can stay focused on content, strategy, and growing the community.



This is not a basic data entry role. You will be working inside GoHighLevel every day — building pipelines, setting up automations, managing contacts, and keeping the business running. You will also manage our community platform (Circle) and handle daily admin, scheduling, and communication via Slack.



If you know GoHighLevel well, you're organised, and you like systems — this role is for you.



What you'll do



GoHighLevel — the core of the role



Upload emails I write and schedule them to the list

Build and manage automation sequences and pipelines — including a follow-up sequence for leads who don't convert within the 7-day window

Set up new sub-accounts in GHL when members request GoHighLevel access

Manage contacts — tagging, pipeline stages, keeping records clean

Monitor automations and flag anything not working correctly



Community (Circle)



Manage the migration of our existing community from Skool to Circle — inviting members, sending instructions, tracking who has moved, chasing anyone who hasn't

Welcome every new member when they join

Monitor Circle daily for unanswered posts and flag anything that needs a response

Keep the community tidy and organised



Content and Social Media



Upload content I create and schedule it across social media platforms

Simple video edits — trimming, captioning, cutting longer videos into short clips (CapCut or similar)

Maintain a content tracker so nothing gets missed or double-posted



Daily Operations



Send a daily Slack briefing every morning before 9am UK time: 3 things that need my attention today, what's scheduled to go out, anything outstanding

Manage my shared inbox in GHL — flag messages that need my response, handle simple admin replies

General admin tasks as they come up — file organisation, updating trackers, keeping things running



What you won't do



Write content or copy — that comes from me

Speak to members or clients directly

Make decisions without checking with me first



What I need from you



Proven GoHighLevel experience — non-negotiable. You must have built pipelines and automations before, not just uploaded contacts or sent emails

Experience managing an email list — scheduling broadcasts, building sequences

Familiar with Circle or a similar community platform

Basic video editing (CapCut or equivalent)

Slack — you will use this every day for communication and daily briefings

Reliable, fast internet and consistent availability — you must be able to send the daily briefing before 9am UK time

Strong attention to detail

Someone who asks when unsure rather than guesses



Shortlisted candidates will be given a short practical GoHighLevel test before being hired. This is how I confirm you can do what you say. Please only apply if you are confident completing a live task in GHL.



Hours and pay



15–20 hours per week to start, with potential to grow as the business grows. Rate based on experience — please include your expected hourly rate in your application.



This is a long-term role. I am not looking for someone for a month.



How to apply



Start your application with the word CLINIC — applications that don't start with this will not be read.



Then tell me:



Your GoHighLevel experience — have you built pipelines and automations? Give me a specific example of what you built and what it did

One role where you managed someone else's content or operations

Your expected hourly rate

Your availability and what time you would be able to send a daily Slack message before 9am UK time



Practical Test (for shortlisted candidates)



Send this to candidates you want to assess before hiring:



"Please complete the following task in a GHL demo account or your own sub-account and send me a short Loom showing what you built:



1. Create a pipeline called 'New Lead' with three stages: Loom Sent, Followed Up, Converted

2. Set up an automation that triggers when a contact is moved to the 'Followed Up' stage and sends them an email 24 hours later with the subject line 'Just checking in'

3. Add one SMS step 48 hours after the email



This should take you no more than 20–30 minutes if you know GHL well."



Anyone who can't complete that cleanly isn't the right hire.

title: Digital Revenue & Opportunities Researcher
description:
We are looking for an extremely resourceful, entrepreneurial, and internet-savvy person whose primary responsibility will be finding and validating new ways for our company to generate revenue online.



This is NOT a traditional virtual assistant position.



Your job is not simply to search YouTube, TikTok, Reddit, or Google and send us interesting videos or business ideas.



Your job is to FIND opportunities, RESEARCH them, VALIDATE them, and help us determine which ones are actually worth pursuing.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will continuously research digital and online revenue opportunities, including but not limited to:



• YouTube and content businesses

• YouTube clipping and short-form content

• Faceless social media accounts

• Affiliate marketing

• Digital products

• AI-powered businesses

• Lead generation

• Online service businesses

• Automation opportunities

• E-commerce

• Online marketplaces

• Emerging platforms and business models

• New trends that could potentially generate revenue



You should also be willing to discover opportunities we haven’t thought of yet.



RESEARCH & VALIDATION



Finding an idea is only the beginning.



For promising opportunities, you will research:



• How the business actually makes money

• Who the customers are

• Examples of people or companies successfully doing it

• Startup costs

• Software and tools required

• Competition

• Potential profit margins

• Time required to launch

• Estimated time to first revenue

• Scalability

• Automation potential

• Platform risks

• Legal or business risks

• Reasons the idea could fail



You should be naturally skeptical.



If someone online claims they are making $20,000 per month from a business model, we don’t automatically believe them.



We investigate it.



TESTING OPPORTUNITIES



The best ideas will move beyond research.



You may be asked to help us create small, inexpensive tests to determine whether an opportunity actually works.



Example:



Instead of simply telling us that a YouTube clipping business could make money, we may create an account, publish content, track the results, study monetization requirements, and determine whether the business deserves additional investment.



We believe in testing ideas instead of endlessly discussing them.



WEEKLY EXPECTATIONS



Each week you should be able to explain:



What opportunities did you research?



Which ones did you eliminate and why?



Which opportunities deserve further research?



Which opportunities should we test?



Which ONE opportunity do you believe currently has the greatest potential and why?



Your performance will NOT be measured by how many ideas you send us.



It will be measured by your ability to identify legitimate opportunities, eliminate bad ideas quickly, create intelligent experiments, and ultimately help us develop new sources of revenue.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a great fit if you are:



• Entrepreneurial

• Extremely curious

• Resourceful

• Internet savvy

• Comfortable researching independently

• Comfortable using AI tools

• Familiar with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and other digital platforms

• Able to understand basic business economics

• Analytical but creative

• Comfortable with spreadsheets and numbers

• Able to communicate research clearly

• Naturally skeptical of online “get rich quick” claims

• Someone who enjoys figuring out how businesses make money



Previous experience building online businesses, side hustles, content accounts, digital products, e-commerce businesses, or similar projects is highly valued.



We are more interested in how you THINK than having a perfect résumé.



APPLICATION TEST



Please do not send us a generic application. Email your CV and answers to 
 be considered, answer the following:



Find 3 legitimate online business opportunities that could potentially be launched with less than $1,000.



For each opportunity briefly explain:



1. What the business is

2. How it makes money

3. Estimated startup cost

4. How quickly it could realistically generate its first revenue

5. The biggest risk

6. Why you believe the opportunity is worth considering



Then rank all three opportunities.



Finally, give us a simple 30-day execution plan for your #1 choice.



We are looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, not someone who simply searches Google.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are building multiple businesses and revenue streams.



If you consistently discover and help develop profitable opportunities, this position can grow significantly.



Our goal is to build a team that continuously discovers opportunities, tests them, launches the winners, and then builds systems and teams around the businesses that work.

title: Outbound Sales & Content Virtual Assistant – Employer Partnerships
description:
Respectable Results is a U.S.-based workforce development company. We help employers address hiring and workforce needs while helping job seekers connect with employment opportunities.



We are looking for a confident, persistent, resourceful Virtual Assistant who can help us grow employer partnerships, schedule discovery calls, create professional social media content, and eventually conduct employer discovery calls independently.



This is NOT a basic administrative VA position.



A major part of this role involves speaking with U.S. employers. You must be comfortable picking up the phone, getting past gatekeepers, speaking with hiring managers and HR professionals, handling objections, following up consistently, and turning conversations into scheduled meetings.



We are looking for someone who can think independently, solve problems, and take initiative, not someone who needs step-by-step instructions every time something does not go according to plan.



Primary Responsibilities:



Employer Outreach & Appointment Setting



Make outbound calls to U.S. employers during Central Time business hours.

Contact hiring managers, HR professionals, recruiters, business owners, and other decision-makers.

Learn about employers' current hiring and workforce needs.

Schedule qualified discovery calls.

Confidently navigate receptionists and gatekeepers.

Handle common objections professionally.

Conduct persistent but professional follow-up by phone and email.

Research employers before and after calls when appropriate.

Identify companies that may be actively hiring.

Find alternative contacts when the original contact is unavailable.

Maintain organized notes, statuses, contact information, and follow-up dates.

Track outreach activity and results.

Work toward weekly outreach, conversation, follow-up, and appointment-setting goals.

You must be comfortable hearing “no,” “not interested,” “send me something,” or “they're unavailable” without becoming discouraged.

When one method does not work, we expect you to think about what you can try next.



Discovery Calls & Employer Relationship Development



Initially, your primary responsibility will be getting qualified employers onto discovery calls with company leadership.

As you learn our company, services, messaging, and employer partnership model, you may be trained to lead discovery calls yourself.



This may include:

Asking employers questions about hiring challenges.

Identifying recruitment and retention problems.

Learning what positions employers are struggling to fill.

Identifying pain points and workforce needs.

Determining whether an employer is a good partnership opportunity.

Explaining appropriate company services.

Handling basic objections and questions.

Establishing clear next steps.

Documenting the employer's needs and follow-up requirements.

Maintaining relationships with prospective employer partners.

There is an opportunity for this position to grow into a larger business development and employer partnership role.



Social Media & Content Creation



This position will also assist with creating and scheduling content.

Responsibilities may include:

Create professional static social media graphics.

Turn existing photos, videos, information, and ideas into branded content.

Edit short-form videos and Reels.

Add captions, hooks, text overlays, transitions, music, and calls-to-action when appropriate.

Use Canva and/or similar graphic-design platforms.

Follow an established brand style.

Repurpose existing content into multiple posts.

Schedule approved content on platforms such as Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.

Organize photos, videos, graphics, and other media assets.

Make basic edits to presentations and marketing materials when needed.

You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but your work should look polished, modern, clean, and appropriate for a professional U.S. business.



Sales, Marketing & Business Development Support



Additional responsibilities may include:

Research potential employer partners.

Build targeted employer prospect lists.

Research companies before discovery calls.

Identify the appropriate hiring or HR contact.

Research open positions and hiring activity.

Update employer outreach trackers or CRM records.

Draft follow-up emails.

Prepare information before meetings.

Update simple sales presentations.

Track employer partnership opportunities.

Identify potential community partners.

Research networking and business-development opportunities.

Maintain organized records of outreach campaigns.

Provide weekly reports on activity, results, challenges, and opportunities.



Who We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you are:

Very confident speaking on the phone.

Persistent without being rude or overly aggressive.

Comfortable initiating conversations with people you do not know.

Comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners, HR professionals, hiring managers, recruiters, and executives.

Able to speak clear, polished, easy-to-understand professional English.

Experienced with cold calling, warm calling, telesales, appointment setting, recruitment, business development, or lead generation.

Able to think independently.

A strong problem solver.

Comfortable making decisions within your responsibilities.

Someone who looks for another solution when the first option does not work.

Highly dependable.

Excellent with follow-up.

Comfortable being held accountable for measurable results.

Organized enough to manage multiple employer leads and follow-ups.

Able to write professional emails in English.

Comfortable using Canva.

Capable of basic short-form video editing.

Comfortable learning new software and AI tools.

Able to research information online efficiently.

Able to receive feedback and improve quickly.

Comfortable working independently without constant supervision.

Experience in recruitment, staffing, HR, workforce development, B2B sales, U.S. call-center operations, appointment setting, or business development is strongly preferred.



Technical Requirements

You must have:

Reliable high-speed internet.

Reliable computer.

Quality headset.

Quiet professional environment for employer calls.

Reliable availability during agreed work hours.

Ability to work during at least a portion of U.S. Central Time business hours.

Experience with any of the following is helpful:

Canva

CapCut or similar video-editing software

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office

CRM systems

Social media scheduling platforms

Business phone systems or dialers

LinkedIn

Meta Business Suite

AI tools such as ChatGPT



Compensation

Starting Pay: $3–$5 USD per hour depending on experience, skills, and demonstrated ability.

This position also includes opportunities for performance bonuses ($10USD per successful outcome)



Bonuses may be earned based on outcomes such as:

Successful employer partnerships.

Employer relationships that lead to successful hiring outcomes.

Other measurable revenue-producing results.

We are interested in rewarding people who help create real business results — not simply someone who completes a list of tasks.



Strong performance can lead to:

Increased compensation.

Additional bonuses.

Increased hours.

Greater responsibility.

Leading discovery calls.

Expanded business-development responsibilities.

Long-term growth within the company.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a generic application.



To be considered, please answer ALL of the questions below in your application message.



**1. Voice Introduction**

Send a link to a 60–90 second audio or video introduction. Tell us your name, your previous outbound calling or appointment-setting experience, who you have called in previous roles, and why you are good at getting decision-makers to speak with you.



**2. Gatekeeper Scenario**

You are calling a U.S.-based company to learn about its hiring needs and schedule a business discovery call.



The receptionist asks:



“What exactly are you calling about?”



Write exactly what you would say.



**4. Problem-Solving Scenario**

You have called an employer three times. The hiring manager has not returned your calls, but you know the company is actively hiring.



What would you do next? Be specific.



**5. Discovery Call Scenario**

A business owner tells you:



“We’re having trouble hiring people, and when we do hire them, they don’t stay very long.”



What five questions would you ask before recommending a solution?



**6. Independence Question**

Tell us about a time when something went wrong while completing a task and, instead of immediately asking your manager what to do, you found another way to complete it.



Tell us what happened, what you did, and the result.



**7. Portfolio**

Provide links to:



* 2–3 static social media graphics you personally created.

* At least 1 short-form video or Reel you personally edited.



**8. Experience**

Tell us which of the following you have experience with:

Canva, CapCut, CRM systems, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn, social media scheduling tools, business phone systems/dialers, and AI tools.



**9. Availability**

Include:



* Your current location and time zone.

* Your available working hours.

* Whether you can make calls during U.S. Central Time business hours.

* Your requested hourly rate.

* Your preferred weekly hours.

title: Business Process & SOP Specialist
description:
Business Process & SOP Specialist

 Mortgage and Insurance Business



**Type of Work:** Part-time, project-based

**Hours:** Approximately 15–20 hours per week

**Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during New Zealand business hours

**Compensation:** Negotiable based on experience and demonstrated capability

**Potential:** Opportunity for ongoing systems-maintenance work after the initial project



## About the Business



Life Protector Limited is a New Zealand financial advice business supporting clients with home loans, personal and business loans, insurance, KiwiSaver and related financial services.



We are building a structured, scalable and franchise-ready operating system. We need an experienced Business Process & SOP Specialist who can convert our existing workflows into clear, practical and controlled operating procedures.



This is not a general virtual assistant or data-entry position. We need someone who can analyse processes, identify gaps and create systems that a new team member can follow with minimal supervision.



## Primary Objective



Your primary responsibility will be to document, organise and improve the business’s operational processes.



You will work directly with the Owner-Director and relevant team members to capture how work is currently performed, identify inefficiencies and convert each workflow into a complete operating system.



The finished procedures must be clear enough for a newly hired team member to follow without repeatedly asking the owner for instructions.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Process Discovery and Mapping



* Interview the Owner-Director and team members to understand existing workflows.

* Review recorded demonstrations, notes, templates, checklists and existing documents.

* Map processes from initial client enquiry through application, approval, implementation, settlement and ongoing service.

* Identify decision points, dependencies, handoffs, delays, duplication and operational risks.

* Separate adviser responsibilities from administrative responsibilities.

* Identify situations that must be escalated to the adviser or management.



### 2. SOP Development



* Create clear, step-by-step standard operating procedures.

* Convert Loom or meeting recordings into structured written procedures.

* Create Scribe guides with screenshots and instructions where appropriate.

* Include the purpose, scope, responsible person, required inputs, process steps, quality checks, exceptions and escalation rules in every SOP.

* Ensure instructions are practical, concise and easy to follow.

* Create supporting checklists, templates, forms and scripts.

* Include relevant compliance checkpoints without attempting to provide legal or financial advice.



### 3. Workflow and Systems Improvement



* Review existing processes and recommend practical improvements.

* Eliminate unnecessary duplication and unclear responsibilities.

* Establish consistent handoffs between advisers, processors, administrators and customer-service staff.

* Recommend where automation may improve efficiency or reduce human error.

* Work with our automation specialist when a documented workflow is ready to be automated.

* Ensure that human approval remains in place for sensitive, compliance-related or adviser-only decisions.



### 4. Document Management and Governance



* Design a logical SOP library and folder structure.

* Establish document-naming conventions.

* Create an SOP register showing document owner, version number, approval date and next review date.

* Maintain change logs and version histories.

* Ensure outdated procedures are clearly identified and replaced.

* Create a controlled process for reviewing and approving SOP updates.



### 5. Training and Implementation



* Create onboarding and role-specific training materials.

* Help turn SOPs into practical training modules.

* Test procedures with actual team members.

* Observe where users become confused and revise the procedure accordingly.

* Create competency checklists for new employees.

* Support the implementation of the completed systems across the business.



## Initial Priority Workflows



The initial project may include:



* New client enquiry and lead management

* Client onboarding

* Mortgage discovery and document collection

* Preliminary mortgage assessment

* Loan application preparation and submission

* Conditional approval management

* Unconditional approval and settlement preparation

* Insurance advice administration

* Insurance application processing

* Outstanding insurance requirements and underwriting follow-ups

* Personal and business loan processing

* CRM data-entry standards

* Client communication and follow-up

* Complaints and escalation procedures

* File checking and quality assurance

* Adviser and VA task handovers

* New employee onboarding

* Weekly operational reporting



## Required Experience



Applicants must have:



* Proven experience creating business SOPs and process documentation.

* Strong process-mapping or business-analysis skills.

* Experience converting unstructured information into clear procedures.

* Excellent written English and attention to detail.

* Experience creating checklists, templates, process maps and training materials.

* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.

* Experience with tools such as Scribe, Loom, L
, Miro, Notion, ClickUp, Asana or similar systems.

* An understanding of document control, version management and review cycles.

* The ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.

* The confidence to identify unclear, inefficient or incomplete processes and recommend improvements.



## Highly Desirable Experience



Preference may be given to applicants with experience in:



* Mortgage, lending, insurance or financial services

* Other regulated or compliance-sensitive businesses

* New Zealand or Australian professional-services businesses

* CRM documentation and implementation

* Remote-team operations

* Quality-assurance systems

* Franchise operations or franchise-readiness projects

* Workflow automation using n8n, Make, Zapier or GoHighLevel



Direct automation expertise is helpful but not mandatory. Your primary responsibility is to understand, improve and document the business process correctly before it is automated.



## Scope and Authority



This is a process-development and operational-documentation role.



You will not be authorised to:



* Provide financial advice to clients

* Recommend financial products

* Make lending or insurance decisions

* Represent yourself as a financial adviser

* Approve regulated advice or compliance decisions



Any matter involving financial advice, adviser judgement or regulatory interpretation must be escalated to the Owner-Director or authorised adviser.



## Required Deliverables



Each completed process should ordinarily include:



1. Process overview and objective

2. Scope and process boundaries

3. Roles and responsibilities

4. Required inputs and documents

5. Step-by-step procedure

6. Process flowchart

7. Operational checklist

8. Quality-control checkpoints

9. Exceptions and escalation rules

10. Relevant templates and scripts

11. System access or tool requirements

12. Completion evidence and recordkeeping requirements

13. Document owner, version and review date

14. Training or competency checklist



## Performance Measures



Performance will be assessed according to:



* Accuracy and completeness of documented procedures

* Ease of use for new team members

* Reduction in repeated questions to the Owner-Director

* Number of approved workflows completed

* Adherence to agreed deadlines

* Quality of process maps, checklists and supporting templates

* Identification and correction of workflow gaps

* Successful testing of SOPs by team members

* Proper version control and document organisation



Producing a large number of superficial documents will not be considered successful. Quality, clarity and practical usability are more important than volume.



## Paid Practical Assessment



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical assessment.



You will receive a short recording explaining a fictional business process and will be asked to produce:



* A process map

* A concise written SOP

* An operational checklist

* Quality-control checkpoints

* Exception and escalation procedures

* A basic document-control record



The assessment will be time-limited. Applicants will not be asked to complete free work using genuine client information.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. A brief explanation of your relevant experience

2. At least two examples of SOPs or process documents you personally created

3. One example of a process map, workflow or checklist

4. A list of the SOP and process-mapping tools you use

5. Your experience with financial services or other regulated industries

6. Your hourly rate and weekly availability

7. Your availability during New Zealand business hours

8. A short explanation of how you would turn a recorded process demonstration into a complete SOP



Please begin your application with the words **“PROCESS FIRST”** so we can confirm that you read the complete job description.



Applications containing only a generic résumé or an AI-generated cover letter without relevant work samples will not be shortlisted.

title: Creative Producer for Game Advertising (Part Time, Long Term, Growing to Full Time)

This starts at 20 hours per week. We have two larger engagements closing in the next quarter and this role grows to full time as they land. We are hiring now because we would rather find the right person early than rush later.



What You Will Do



Study each game and develop the creative angles we test. Write the scripts, the hooks, and the ad copy yourself.



Build shot lists for gameplay capture and brief our capture operator against them.



Brief and direct our editor, our motion work, and our AI video and image generation. Review what comes back, give clear notes, and push it to final delivery.

What We Need

title: Remote Manual QA Tester / VA — Website & App Testing
description:
Company: 

Location: Remote

Primary focus: Manual testing, bug reporting, and user-experience quality



About the role



I’m looking for a careful, methodical QA tester to help improve Bellaura, a platform for creators and creative professionals.



Your job will be to use the platform from the perspective of different users, identify problems, document them clearly, and verify that fixes work. I need someone who goes beyond checking whether a button can be clicked and thinks about whether the full experience makes sense.



Strong written and spoken English is required. Clear written communication is especially important: your bug reports should help a developer understand and reproduce an issue without unnecessary back-and-forth.



What you’ll do

Test complete user journeys, including account creation, login, profiles, media uploads, discovery, events, messaging, and booking flows as available.

Check functionality and presentation across agreed desktop and mobile browsers, screen sizes, and user roles.

Test both normal behavior and edge cases, such as missing information, invalid inputs, repeated actions, interrupted flows, and different permission levels.

Write reproducible bug reports with steps, expected versus actual results, environment details, impact, and supporting screenshots or recordings.

Retest fixes, maintain regression checklists, and flag confusing wording, broken layouts, inconsistent behavior, and usability problems.

Who I’m looking for



You should have hands-on experience with manual website or app testing and be comfortable documenting your work in an issue tracker or structured task system.



You need patience, curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to separate a reproducible defect from a suggestion or personal preference. You should keep testing records organized and communicate what is blocked, what has passed, and what still needs investigation.



Coding is not required. Experience with browser developer tools, automated testing, or Playwright is a plus. Testing must use approved accounts and data, with appropriate care for private information.



Additional skills I strongly prefer



QA testing is the priority for this listing, but ideally you also have experience in executive assistance, video editing, and photo editing.



I would prefer one versatile candidate who can contribute across multiple areas. Administrative organization and follow-through are particularly useful alongside testing, and candidates who can also produce good photo and video edits are especially interesting.



For the creative side of the role, my preference is to have photo and video editing handled by the same person.



How to apply



Please send an introduction in English describing your testing experience, the types of products you have tested, and the tools you use. Include one or two anonymized bug-report examples, or create a sample report that demonstrates how you document an issue.



Summarize your experience across all four areas and include editing portfolios if relevant. Also provide your time zone, weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.

title: Business Development & Marketing Specialist
description:

* You must maintain accurate records of all leads and activities

* You must be reliable, organised, and able to meet deadlines

* You must have excellent English communication skills

* You must have reliable high-speed internet and a professional home working environment

* You must be willing to transition from working at home to working in an office



The Right Mindset



We are looking for someone who:



* Is confident, professional, and comfortable starting conversations

* Takes initiative and does not wait to be told what to do

* Understands that successful business development requires patience and consistent follow-up

* Is motivated by targets and measurable achievements

* Can handle rejection without losing enthusiasm

* Looks for opportunities and proposes practical ideas

* Takes ownership rather than making excuses

* Is honest and realistic when reporting results

* Wants to play an important role in growing a business

* Is willing to learn about debt collection and UCC’s international services



Why Join UCC?



* Work with an established international company

* Play a central role in expanding UCC’s Philippine operation

* Market a professional service that helps businesses improve their cash flow

* Communicate with business owners and senior decision-makers

* Receive training and support from an experienced international debt recovery company

* Develop your career as the Philippine business grows

* Work from home initially before transitioning to an office

title: Cold Caller / Live Transfer Dialer – Commercial Cleaning (US Night Shift, Full-Time)

READ THIS FIRST: You must ALREADY know commercial cleaning. WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

- Get past the front desk and reach the person who d
 on the cleaning vendor (owner, office manager, facilities manager)

HOURS

Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM US Pacific time (that is 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Manila). Night shift only. Do not apply if you cannot work these hours.

$4.00 per hour, 40 hours per week ($160/week, about $690/month), paid weekly through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay, PLUS a $4 bonus for every live transfer that our sales team turns into a booked walkthrough. A strong caller adds $40 to $80 a week in bonuses. This is serious, full-time work with a real daily target. Paid 3-day trial first (real calls, real leads, real pay), then full-time if you hit the numbers.



REQUIREMENTS

- REQUIRED: 1+ year working in or calling for a commercial cleaning / janitorial company (US clients preferred). You must know the industry, not just cold calling

- Outbound cold calling experience to US businesses (B2B, lead generation, appointment setting)

- Clear, confident spoken English. You will be talking to office managers and business owners

- Stable internet, quiet workspace, USB headset

- Comfortable with a daily target: 60 dials, 6+ live transfers to our sales team

- Available for the US Pacific night shift above



HOW TO APPLY (do all 4 or you will not be considered)

1. Put the word TRANSFER in the first line of your application

2. Name the commercial cleaning or janitorial company you worked for or called for, how long, and what you did there

3. Send a 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link) of you calling an office and asking for the person who handles the cleaning vendor

4. Tell us how many outbound dials per day you made at your last calling job

title: Producer | Founder-Led Content
description:
You've had this job before. You just never had the title.



You were the editor, the VA, the "content manager." But you were the one who actually ran the show. You built the process nobody asked for. You chased the founder for footage. You rebuilt the week around the session he missed. And when it went out late, YOU heard about it.



You can see the whole machine. You've just never been handed the keys.



I'm the founder. I'm the face. I'm the decision-maker. I am also, consistently, the bottleneck. I know it. I'm hiring you to fix it.



The Work



We're building a show: daily video content from me, turned into content everywhere my market lives, with paid promotion behind it. The system exists in my head (and in the process I run for my clients.) It does NOT (yet) exist on paper.



Job one is standing it up WITH me. 

Scheduled working sessions, you and I, pulling the loop out of my head and into a production you can run. 

You'll be in the room for the layout, not handed a manual afterward.



Job two is running it. 

You own the schedule. 

You get me in front of the camera. 

You drive the raw through edit, audit, approval, and launch, and you don't let it sit. 



I make the calls. 

You make sure the calls get made, on time, and executed.



Job three is earned: 

the loop gets tight enough that I only record and steer, 

and YOU run the whole show.



What can't be taught is HOW YOU'RE WIRED. 



You start things and you don't let go. 

A rough vision energizes you. 

A founder who's hard to pin down doesn't scare you. 



You've done this for someone else's face - and you were good at it.



The Offer



Direct access to the owner. A schedule that's yours to protect. Real authority over the production, starting day one. A show you helped design and then get to run. And a role that grows into showrunner if you earn it, because I'd rather promote the person who built it than hire over them.



To Apply



Tell me two things, briefly:



A time you turned someone's loose idea into a process that actually ran.

A time the person you depended on kept NOT delivering, and what you did about it.



In Closing



If you want to be told what to do each day, this isn't for you. 

If you need a finished SOP before you can move, this isn't for you. 

If what you really want is to be the strategist, this isn't for you either. (The decisions stay with me.)



But if you read the first ten lines and felt seen, you already know. 

Send it!
