title: Paid Media Specialist (Performance Marketing)
description:
Starting USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month | Full-time | Remote | Fast-track hiring | Hire by Sep 25 | Asia Time Zone



---



Are you a performance marketer who knows why the numbers moved, not just what they are?



This is a high-caliber, high-growth marketing team with ambitions to scale significantly further. They are adding paid media capacity — not to maintain what is running, but to push harder on what is already working and open up what is next.



Apply below to own real ad channels across Meta, TikTok, Google and more — with stable clients and active coaching in AI workflows.







---



[1] About Ally



Ally helps founders and leaders scale themselves before they scale their companies.



Founded by leaders who have scaled and operated 8-figure+ businesses, we partner with top operators and support clients including a NASDAQ-listed company.



We match Executive Partners (EPs) with fast-growing e-commerce and creative businesses to bring structure, clarity, and execution leverage — blending human judgment with modern AI systems.



We're not a traditional VA agency. We're a modern operating partner helping global teams run smarter and faster.



This role sits with one of our clients — a team that took a consumer health brand from zero to $100M USD. Built by operators who previously scaled a NASDAQ-listed company, Casetify, and Peak21, the brand crossed 8-figure revenue and 1M+ customers in under 36 months. You would work inside their marketing team, with Ally behind you.



---



[2] The Role



As an Executive Partner in paid media, you will own the performance of the ad channels we give you. You buy the media, watch the numbers every day, and tell the team what they mean and what to do next.



Leadership does not open the ad platforms. They read your report. That means your report has to be right every single day, and it has to come with a point of view, not just a set of figures.



For your first month or two you will bring your recommendations to the marketing lead for approval. Once you have shown you can read the numbers, you optimise on your own.



---



[3] What You'll Do



What you own:



- How your channels perform. Keep the channels assigned to you running, and grow them. That means managing the spend, creating and managing the ad accounts, setting up a replacement when one gets rejected, and flagging billing before a lapse stops our campaigns.

- The daily report. Build and maintain it across every funnel, and know why each formula works rather than just where to type the number. Leadership never opens the ad platforms, they read your report. It has to be right every day.

- How the agency content performs. Several agencies produce and post content for us. You get it live as ads on time, and you own how it does once it is running.

- Keeping the accounts alive. Our product category is high risk for ad and account bans. Monitor policy changes, spot the risk early, and act before a channel gets disrupted.

- Spotting things first. Flag underperformance, anomalies or opportunities before anyone asks.



What you work out:



- Analyze the data. Not just what happened, but why, and what to do next.

- Analyze creatives against performance and say what we should make more of.

- Research what is working for other brands and competitors. Not just ads: landing pages, messaging, offers and campaign strategies. Bring back specific things we should test, and draft the advertorials yourself (AI tools welcome).

- Look beyond your own assignment. Check what is happening on the other channels so you understand the whole picture.



What you run day to day:



- Launch ads at volume across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola and Google. Several hundred a week, mostly through bulk tools rather than one at a time.

- Work with our internal creative team and our external agencies on what is coming and when.

- Work directly with platform reps on rejections, approvals and questions.



---



[4] What Success Looks Like at 90 Days



- Your channels are growing. Spend and revenue up, ROAS held at target.

- You have a repeatable way to test creatives, and you are consistently finding and scaling the winners.

- Nothing has stopped. No campaign down because of a billing lapse, a rejected account, or a policy change you did not see coming.

- Your reports are trusted. Leadership d
 off them without going to check the platforms.

- You are bringing ideas, not just numbers. Things you found working for other brands that we should be testing.



---



[5] What We're Looking For



- You understand how paid ads work on at least one platform. Not just uploading. You know what to check, what to look at, and why. This is the one thing we cannot train from zero.

- Initiative. You see what needs doing and you do it. We can tell within a week who has this and who does not.

- You ask questions constantly. We would rather you ask ten times a day than stay quiet and hand in a report with mistakes in it.

- You treat the work as yours. The people who do well here push on something because they spotted the opportunity, not because someone asked them to.

- Strong attention to detail — accuracy in the data, polish in the presentation.

- Able to present data clearly — formatting, structure and visual clarity matter.

- Open to working on any platform — Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Reddit, Taboola, Google. You may be strongest on one, but you will not get to stay there.

- Comfortable with bulk launch tooling like AdManage or Revealbot, or able to pick it up fast.

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and numbers.

- Familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel.

- Has used AI tools in their workflow (preferred, not required).

- Agency or in-house media buying experience is a plus. Time served matters less than knowing what you are looking at.



One thing this role is not: you will not be designing creatives. Our internal team and our agencies produce the assets. You shape what they make by telling them what the data says is working, and you will write advertorials yourself.



If you have read this far: open your video by naming which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched. Be honest. Nobody has all six, and we would rather know now.



---



[6] Schedule



5 days a week, 8am to 5pm Philippine time. Your two days off include one weekday, so one of your five working days falls on a weekend and the team always has coverage. We will confirm which days when we assign your channels.



If we ask you to cover a sixth day, that is overtime.



---



[7] What You'll Get



- Attractive starting rate and grow fast — starting at USD $1,000 - $1,400 / month

- Two weeks of one-on-one walkthrough training with the marketing lead

- Paid subscriptions to the tools you need

- Direct access to global founders and operators

- Mentorship and clear growth paths

- Real spend across six platforms on a brand that is scaling. That is a track record you can point at later.

- Fully remote setup

- Asia Time Zone

- Work that truly matters — every report you build drives real revenue decisions for global brands



---



[8] HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application here:







You will be asked to:



1. Upload your CV or LinkedIn profile

2. Record a short Loom video (2-3 mins) covering:

- Which of our six platforms you have actually run ads on, and which you have never touched

- Your relevant paid media or marketing experience

- Why you are interested in this role



In the video, also answer this:



Last 7 days, three ads:



- Ad A: $120 spent, 1 purchase, $95 revenue

- Ad B: $2,400 spent, 41 purchases, $4,300 revenue

- Ad C: $310 spent, 6 purchases, $680 revenue



Which one would you scale, and why? A minute is plenty. We are listening for how you think, not how polished you are. It is the main thing we shortlist on.



Applications sent outside this link will not be reviewed.



---



[9] OTHER OPEN POSITIONS AT ALLY



We are actively hiring for other Executive Partner roles across operations, marketing, and executive support.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
# 🌟 Executive & Personal Assistant



We are seeking an exceptional **Executive & Personal Assistant** to support an entrepreneur across a growing portfolio of businesses, emerging ventures, and personal priorities. This is a **high-trust role** for someone who can create clarity, maintain momentum, protect the owner’s time, and make sure important commitments move forward.  



The right person will do more than complete assigned tasks. You should be resourceful, highly organized, adaptable, comfortable learning quickly, and able to bring structure to unfamiliar situations. You’ll help the owner stay focused on leadership, revenue, growth, relationships, and new opportunities. 🚀 



## 🎯 The Purpose of This Role



Your primary responsibility is to reduce the **administrative, organizational, coordination, research, and follow-up workload** surrounding the business owner.



Success means the owner spends less time tracking, reminding, organizing, scheduling, researching, and following up — and more time **leading and building.** ✨ 



## 📋 What You’ll Help With



### 📅 Executive Calendar & Priorities



* Manage business and personal calendars

* Coordinate meetings, appointments, calls, events, property visits, and travel

* Identify scheduling conflicts and missing preparation time

* Prepare concise briefings covering priorities, deadlines, appointments, and decisions

* Keep postponed or deprioritized work visible for appropriate follow-up 



### 📧 Inbox & Communications



* Organize and triage business and personal communications

* Draft polished emails, messages, responses, and follow-ups

* Learn and accurately reflect the owner’s communication style

* Flag communications requiring a decision, approval, or sensitive response

* Follow up with employees, vendors, clients, partners, contractors, advisors, and other contacts

* Handle correspondence with discretion 🔐 



### 📝 Meetings & Follow-Up



* Prepare agendas, background information, documents, and decision points

* Record decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines

* Track follow-ups and completion

* Escalate delays, risks, or missing information before they become urgent

* Turn lengthy information into concise summaries and recommended next steps 



### 📊 Business & Project Coordination



* Maintain visibility across business priorities and new ventures

* Track projects, deadlines, dependencies, opportunities, and outstanding decisions

* Coordinate information between the owner, team members, VAs, contractors, and outside professionals

* Conduct research and prepare concise decision briefs

* Help organize new projects and unfamiliar business opportunities

* Ensure delegated work has a clear outcome, owner, deadline, and follow-up point 



### 💍 Bridal Business Support



* Support executive-level projects involving partnerships, recruiting, financing, marketing, and expansion

* Coordinate assigned deliverables with team members and external partners

* Organize documents, applications, agreements, and business information

* Help strategic initiatives move forward without unnecessarily pulling the owner back into routine operations 



### 🏡 Airbnb & Short-Term Rental Support



* Coordinate property appointments, vendors, maintenance, purchases, and documentation

* Track inspections, renewals, property tasks, deadlines, and outstanding issues

* Research properties, services, regulations, furnishings, pricing, and operational needs

* Organize property records and information 



### 🚀 New Ventures & Special Projects



* Research unfamiliar industries, opportunities, tools, competitors, and service providers

* Turn early-stage ideas into organized project plans

* Establish trackers, folders, timelines, contact lists, and administrative workflows

* Collect information needed for informed decisions

* Adapt as priorities and opportunities evolve 



### 🤝 Team & Delegation Support



* Serve as a reliable coordination point between the owner and her teams

* Route requests to the appropriate person

* Track delegated assignments and follow up

* Help prepare leadership meetings, hiring activities, performance conversations, and team communications

* Identify recurring work that could be delegated, documented, automated, or eliminated

* Help protect the owner from becoming the default person for routine questions 



### 🗂️ Systems & Information Management



* Keep information organized across email, calendars, cloud storage, project-management systems, and communication platforms

* Create and improve templates, trackers, checklists, and SOPs

* Use AI and automation tools responsibly to reduce manual administrative work 🤖

* Maintain reliable sources of truth for priorities, contacts, projects, and follow-ups 



## 🛠️ Skills & Qualifications



We are looking for someone with:



* ⭐ Experience supporting a founder, entrepreneur, executive, business owner, or other high-responsibility environment

* 🎯 Exceptional organization and attention to detail

* ✅ Excellent follow-through and ownership

* ✍️ Strong written communication

* 🧠 Sound judgment and ability to anticipate needs without overstepping authority

* 📊 Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* 🔎 Strong research and problem-solving skills

* 🌱 Ability to learn unfamiliar industries quickly

* 💻 Proficiency with digital productivity, communication, calendar, and project-management tools

* 🤖 Comfort using AI tools to research, organize, draft, summarize, and streamline work

* 🔐 Strong discretion and confidentiality

* 💬 Calm, professional communication — including the confidence to respectfully redirect a busy executive when necessary 



## ✨ You May Be a Great Fit If You...



Naturally notice what needs to happen next and enjoy creating order from many moving pieces.



You can move between different business and personal priorities without losing context, communicate clearly, work independently, and keep the owner appropriately informed.



Most importantly, you understand **when to act, when to recommend, and when to ask.** You build trust through discretion, accuracy, consistency, adaptability, and follow-through. 🌟 



## 🔐 Trust, Judgment & Boundaries



This role comes with meaningful responsibility, but good judgment includes knowing where your authority ends.



You will be trusted to organize, coordinate, research, draft, remind, and follow up within approved guidelines. Significant financial commitments, legal or financial decisions, hiring or compensation decisions, partnerships, confidential disclosures, public statements, and changes to strategic priorities require appropriate approval. 



## 🌱 Why Join?



This is an opportunity to work closely with an entrepreneur across **multiple businesses and emerging ventures**. The position offers meaningful responsibility, varied industry exposure, and the opportunity to grow into a trusted long-term partnership. 



## 🚀 HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT



📌 **All applicants must complete our official Executive & Personal Assistant application form to be considered.**



👉 **APPLY HERE:**

**
**



📝 Please complete the application carefully and provide **all requested information**, including your resume and answers to the role-specific questions.

- Familiarity with creative and performance roles such as Creative Strategist, Video Editor, Graphic Designer, Creative Operations, Media Buyer, Retention, CRO, and amazon related marketplace roles.



- Experience proactively sourcing candidates internationally, especially in the Philippines and Europe.



- Hands-on experience with onboarding, contracts, payroll coordination, performance tracking, employee records, and HR reporting.



- Strong written and spoken English, attention to detail, confidentiality, and follow-up discipline.

title: Creative & Growth Operations Manager - DTC Performance
description:

- Build and continuously improve SOPs, ClickUp/Notion boards, trackers, dashboards, naming conventions, reporting systems, and team workflows.

- Help the team increase output and speed without sacrificing strategic quality or production standards.



Requirements



- 2+ years of experience in Creative Operations, Growth Operations, Creative Project Management, or Production Management.

- Direct experience working with DTC ecommerce brands, performance marketing teams, or direct-response creative agencies.

- Experience coordinating cross-functional teams involving Creative Strategists, media buyers, copywriters, video editors, designers, creators, CRO specialists, funnel builders, or retention teams.

- Strong understanding of the performance creative lifecycle, from research and briefs through production, launch, performance analysis, iteration, and learning documentation.

- Familiarity with direct-response funnels, including advertorials, listicles, pre-landers, landing pages, PDPs, offer testing, upsells, and conversion-focused copy.

- Demonstrated experience building SOPs, production systems, capacity trackers, approval workflows, and operational processes from scratch.

- Strong project management skills across multiple SKUs, campaigns, and concurrent workstreams.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive, with strong ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable working directly with founders and senior functional leads while maintaining clear responsibility across the wider team.

- Proficiency with ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Slack, Google Workspace, or similar project-management and documentation tools.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Availability for substantial working-hour overlap with the Asia-based team.



Why Join Us



- Long-term opportunity with the potential to transition into a full-time contractor role.

- High ownership and direct impact on how the creative and growth organization is built.

- Work directly with the founder and senior specialists across various teams

- Opportunity to build the operating system behind a fast-growing DTC brand



How to apply



Please apply with:

title: Performance Creative Strategist

This role is responsible for driving creative strategy end-to-end — from deep customer and market research, identifying new growth opportunities, developing creative hypotheses, creating high-quality briefs, analyzing performance insights, and building a scalable creative testing system.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop creative strategies, hypotheses, concepts, hooks, and iterations based on customer psychology, market trends, and performance data.



- Create high-quality creative briefs to support a high-volume creative testing pipeline and increase creative velocity across video, UGC, and static ads.



- Analyze creative performance, identify winning patterns, and translate learnings into scalable creative frameworks and iteration strategies.



- Build and improve creative strategy processes, SOPs, and systems to create a repeatable testing engine.



- Collaborate closely with media buyers, designers, editors, and creators to execute and optimize performance creatives.



Requirements

- 2+ years of experience as a Creative Strategist / Performance Creative Strategist for DTC ecommerce brands.



- Strong experience with Meta Ads creative strategy and direct-response marketing.



- Proven experience developing creatives that drive measurable business results, not just engagement.



- Strong understanding of customer psychology, creative testing frameworks, and performance metrics.



- Experience researching markets, competitors, and customer insights to generate new creative directions.



- Ability to analyze why creatives win or lose and turn insights into actionable iterations.



- Experience working with beauty or skincare DTC brands is highly preferred.



- Experience building creative systems, workflows, or SOPs is a strong plus. 



- Experience managing creative strategy for brands with personally attributed ad spend no less than $200K+/month on paid social is highly preferred.



Why Join Us

- Long-term opportunity: with the potential to transition into a long-term full-time contractor role based on mutual fit and performance.



- High ownership & impact: Work directly with the founder and core team to shape the creative strategy and growth direction of a fast-growing DTC brand.

description:

- Push the team toward tech-enabled efficiency



Cross-Functional Leadership

- Run productive meetings that end with decisions and next steps

- Manage internal tea
mbers, contractors, and agency partners



Drive Results & Accountability

- Anticipate risks before they become problems

What Success Looks Like in 90 Days

- Founders have visibility into what’s happening without having to ask

- You’ve implemented 2–3 automations that save the team hours every week

- The team actually uses the systems you’ve built



You’re a Great Fit If You Have

Must-Haves

- 8–12 years working in ecommerce or digital businesses (agency, brand, or marketplace side)

- Direct experience managing ecommerce operations on platforms like Shopify, Amazon, Wayfair, or Walmart

- Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals and campaign execution — you’ve coordinated marketing teams or projects before

- Startup or high-growth company experience where you wore multiple hats and figured things out

- Track record of building systems, SOPs, and processes from scratch — not just operating within existing ones

- Proven ability to lead and manage people with real authority — not just coordinate

- Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

- Tech-savvy mindset — comfortable with new tools and AI/automation



Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as their operational right hand

- Background in catalogue management, product launches, or creative operations

- Hands-on experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, ChatGPT, n8n)

- Knowledge of SEO, marketplaces, or ecommerce analytics

- Experience scaling a business from early stage — you’ve seen what breaks at $1M, $5M, $10M



Tools You’ll Work With

- Project & Collaboration: Asana, Notion, Slack, Loom, Google Workspace

- Ecommerce Platforms: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, marketplace dashboards, ERP/OMS tools

- Automation & AI: Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, various AI tools



Work Setup

This is a fully remote role. You must have:

- Your own reliable laptop/desktop system

- Stable internet connection

- Professional home office setup

- Company-issued hardware is not provided.



Why Join our Company?

- Direct Founder Access — You’ll work directly with founders who value execution over bureaucracy. Your voice matters.

- High Ownership — This isn’t a “wait for instructions” role. You’ll own real business outcomes and shape how we operate.

- Remote Flexibility — Work from anywhere with flexible hours, as long as you have EST overlap for key collaborations.

- Fast-Paced Growth — We’re scaling quickly across channels. You’ll see the direct impact of your work on revenue and growth.

- Tech-Forward Culture — We embrace automation, AI, and smart systems. If you love finding better ways to work, you’ll thrive here.

title: Supply Chain, Procurement & Logistics Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Supply Chain, Procurement & Logistics Manager to coordinate our suppliers, manufacturing facility in Miami, 3PL warehouse, and Amazon shipments.

This is a hands-on position requiring excellent communication, strong follow-through, and the ability to solve problems quickly. You will communicate regularly with partners in the United States, China, and other countries.

This is not an email-only position. You must be comfortable getting on the phone whenever necessary to resolve urgent supplier, manufacturing, inventory, or shipping issues.

Main responsibilities

- Manage the day-to-day relationship with our manufacturer in Miami.

- Ensure ingredients, components, and packaging arrive before scheduled production.

- Coordinate production schedules and track products through completion.

- Communicate with suppliers in China regarding product development, packaging, samples, pricing, lead times, and quality.

- Help develop practical and cost-effective product and packaging solutions.

- Source ingredients, packaging, and other materials from vendors around the world.

- Request quotations, compare suppliers, negotiate pricing, and manage purchase orders.

- Coordinate deliveries of ingredients and packaging to our manufacturer.

- Manage the relationship with our 3PL, including inbound shipments, inventory, fulfillment, returns, and discrepancies.

- Coordinate shipments from the manufacturer to the 3PL and Amazon fulfillment centers.

- Create and monitor Amazon FBA shipment plans, labels, carton details, and delivery requirements.

- Resolve delayed, missing, damaged, or incorrectly received Amazon shipments.

- Track inventory levels, supplier lead times, production deadlines, and reorder requirements.

- Maintain organized records of quotations, purchase orders, product specifications, packaging details, and shipping documents.

- Provide regular updates to company leadership and immediately escalate important issues.

Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory.

- You must be confident and professional when speaking by phone with American and international business partners.

- You must be available for scheduled calls and urgent operational matters during agreed US Eastern Time working hours.

- You must be willing to make calls—not rely only on email or chat—to resolve important issues.

- At least three years of relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, manufacturing, sourcing, or operations.

- Experience working with manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, or 3PL warehouses.

- Experience communicating with Chinese or other international suppliers.

- Strong knowledge of purchase orders, lead times, minimum order quantities, inventory, and freight.

- Strong spreadsheet and organizational skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection, a quiet professional workspace, and dependable phone or online-calling capability.

Preferred experience

- Amazon Seller Central and FBA shipment experience.

- International product, ingredient, or packaging sourcing.

- Packaging development and sample coordination.

- Importing, customs, international freight, duties, and Incoterms.

- Inventory-management or ERP systems.

- Experience supporting a US-based consumer-products company.

- Experience in [your industry or product category].

What success looks like

- Suppliers, the manufacturer, the 3PL, and Amazon remain properly coordinated.

- Materials arrive before production deadlines.

- Production and outbound shipments are completed accurately and on time.

- Inventory shortages and unnecessary overstock are minimized.

- Problems are identified early and resolved without constant supervision.

- Leadership receives accurate and timely updates.

- Product and packaging projects move efficiently from idea to final production.

How to apply

Please include:

1. Your résumé.

2. A brief description of your relevant sourcing, manufacturing, 3PL, and Amazon experience.

3. Your experience communicating with US and Chinese suppliers.

4. Your availability in US Eastern Time.

5. Your expected monthly salary.

6. A 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit for this role.

7. The words “Miami Supply Chain” in your application subject line.

Applications without a video recording will not be considered.

title: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

title: SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR
description:
Remote | Philippines | 20–40+ hours per week



ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an experienced Senior Video Editor to join the Clipfluence team.

But we're not looking for someone who can simply follow an edit.

We're looking for someone who can build one.

Someone we can give raw footage, a client brief and an outcome to, and trust them to make the creative decisions needed to turn it into something worth watching.

You'll work across long-form podcasts, premium YouTube videos, short-form content, trailers, promos and educational/business content.

One project might be a two-hour multicamera podcast. The next could be a highly produced YouTube video requiring B-roll, motion graphics and sound design. Then you might need to turn a long conversation into a 60-second trailer or find the strongest short-form moments within an episode.

We need someone who is comfortable doing all of it.

You'll have support and creative direction when needed, but we're hiring at a senior level because we want someone who brings ideas to an edit rather than waits for them.



ABOUT CLIPFLUENCE

Clipfluence is a video and podcast content agency working with businesses, creators and podcasts around the world.

For 7+ years, we've helped clients turn conversations, ideas and raw footage into content people actually want to watch.

We're a small, experienced team that cares deeply about the work we create. We don't believe great editing means adding as many effects, transitions or captions as possible. It's about understanding the content, the audience and what the edit actually needs.

Sometimes that means motion graphics, B-roll, music and sound design.

Sometimes it means knowing when to get out of the way and let a great moment breathe.

Our clients trust us with their content and their brands, and we're looking for another editor who takes that responsibility as seriously as we do.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING

There is no single "Clipfluence style."

Every client is different, and their content should feel like them, not like it came out of the same editing template.

You'll work across:

Long-form multicamera podcasts

Premium and technical YouTube videos

Educational and talking-head content

Podcast trailers and episode promos

Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

Story-driven and emotional content

Business and industry-specific content

B-roll, motion graphics and sound-design-heavy edits

Simpler edits where the content needs room to breathe

Adaptability is a big part of this role.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

You'll be expected to take ownership of projects from raw footage through to the finished edit.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Editing long-form podcasts and YouTube videos

- Editing multicamera footage with purposeful angle changes

- Building strong openings, cold opens and episode intros

- Creating podcast trailers and episode promos

- Finding the strongest short-form moments within long recordings

- Making independent decisions around pacing, structure and storytelling

- Identifying where B-roll, graphics or supporting visuals strengthen the content

- Creating motion graphics and animated elements when needed

- Using music and sound design intentionally

- Cleaning audio and colour correcting footage

- Checking captions, spelling, graphics and on-screen text

- Organising projects and exporting content correctly

- Responding to feedback and completing revisions efficiently



Most importantly. You won't always be told exactly what to do. We want you to look at the content, understand what it needs and make creative decisions yourself.



WE DON'T MAKE CLIPS JUST TO MAKE CLIPS

Short-form is an important part of what we do, but we're not a clipping company.

A section of a podcast being 60 seconds long doesn't automatically make it a good Reel.

When selecting content, we want you thinking about the person watching it.

Why would they care about this?

Does it teach them something? Make them think? Make them laugh? Surprise them? Make them feel something? Give them something useful? Make them want to hear more?

You need to be comfortable watching long-form content, identifying the moments that actually matter and understanding why a particular moment deserves to become content. You won't always be handed timestamps. Choosing the right moment is part of the job.



PODCAST TRAILERS & PROMOS:

This is an important skill for this role.

You should be able to watch a conversation, understand what's interesting about it and determine how to make someone want to watch more.

Sometimes that means finding multiple moments throughout an episode and weaving them into a compelling 45–90 second story using pacing, music, sound design and visual editing.

Other times, the content calls for something much simpler.

Good editing isn't about doing the most. It's about knowing what the content needs.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

You can edit without constant direction

We don't want to tell you where every cut goes, what B-roll to use or where to add a graphic.

We'll give you context and feedback, particularly as you learn our clients, but we expect you to creatively solve the edit.

You understand what keeps people interested

We're happy to help refine your storytelling skills, but you should already have a strong instinct for what makes content interesting and what makes an edit drag.

You have strong technical skills

This isn't an entry-level editing position.

You should be comfortable with advanced editing, motion graphics, multicam footage, B-roll, audio, colour and sound design.

You're adaptable

Some projects need high-energy technical editing. Others need restraint.

You should be comfortable with both.

You notice the details

Bad cuts, spelling mistakes, inconsistent graphics, poor audio and sloppy exports shouldn't need someone else to point them out.



EXPERIENCE

Previous professional video editing experience is required.

Podcast-specific experience is valuable, but it isn't mandatory.

We'd rather hire an excellent YouTube editor who understands storytelling, pacing and visual communication than an experienced podcast editor who only knows how to switch camera angles and add captions.

If you've worked across podcasts, YouTube, creator content, educational content, documentaries or story-driven videos, we'd love to see it.



You should be comfortable with:

- Professional long-form editing

- Multicamera projects

- Short-form content

- Motion graphics

- B-roll and visual storytelling

- Audio cleanup and sound design

- Colour correction

- Captions and typography

- Masking, tracking and compositing when needed

- Large 4K files and long-form timelines



We don't care which editing software you use. We care about the finished product.

Your portfolio will ultimately matter more to us than which programs you know or the type of clients you've previously worked with.



Here are 2 examples of the style of content you MUST be able to create:



YouTube style - 

Podcast & Trailer style - 



THE KIND OF PERSON WE WANT

You care like it's your own

You take pride in what you create and want the finished piece to be something you're proud of.

You're independent

You don't need someone constantly checking what you're doing or telling you what comes next.

You're creative

You bring ideas and solutions rather than simply executing instructions.

You're reliable

If you commit to something, we need to be able to rely on you to deliver it.

You communicate

If you're unsure, ask. If there's a problem, tell us. If something could affect a deadline, communicate it early.

You're detail-oriented

We work with professional businesses and creators. Small mistakes matter, and we expect you to check your own work before submitting it.

You're open to feedback

Every client is different. Feedback and revisions are part of producing great work, and we expect you to handle them professionally.

You communicate clearly in English

Our clients are primarily Australian and American.

Strong written and spoken English is required.



YOUR SETUP

This is a remote position, so you need the equipment and internet connection to do the job properly.

Our projects regularly involve 4K footage, multiple cameras, long recordings, motion graphics and source files that can exceed 100GB.



You'll need:

- A computer capable of handling professional, technical editing

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Enough storage to comfortably manage large projects

- A reliable working environment during agreed hours

- Your computer and internet cannot be a bottleneck to doing the job.



ROLE DETAILS

Position: Senior Video Editor

Location: Remote, Philippines

Hours: Ideally 40 hours per week, although we're open to strong candidates looking for 20+ hours

Working hours: Initially approximately 9:00am–5:00pm Brisbane time, Monday to Friday

Starting rate: AUD $10–$15 per hour, depending on experience

Initial engagement: 3-month contractor/probationary period

There can be flexibility around working hours once we've established a strong working relationship.

Following the initial three months, there is an opportunity to move into a permanent full-time position if it's a good fit for both sides.

Compensation can also be reviewed based on demonstrated performance and contribution to the team.



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US

We expect a lot from our editors, but we don't expect you to figure everything out alone.

You'll be joining an experienced editing team and will have support as you learn our clients, expectations and workflows.



You can expect:

- Clear briefs and client context

- Creative feedback and support

- A variety of projects and editing styles

- Work with established businesses, creators and podcasts

- Opportunities to develop your storytelling and technical skills

- A remote working environment with more flexibility as trust is established

- We don't expect you to know exactly how every Clipfluence client should be edited on Day 1.

- We do expect you to arrive with the editing ability, creative instinct and willingness to learn that allows us to get you there.



ABOUT WORKING AT CLIPFLUENCE

We're a small team, and we like it that way.

We care about the people we work with, the clients we work for and the content that leaves our hands.

Communication matters. Reliability matters. Quality matters.

And while we take the work seriously, we want Clipfluence to be a genuinely good place to work.

We're looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, learn our clients and create great work consistently rather than simply pick up another freelance editing gig.



HOW TO APPLY

If you've read this and thought "this sounds like me," we'd love to see your work.



Please send us:

- Your CV

- A short introduction about yourself and your professional editing experience

- 3–5 examples of your best work that demonstrate the range of what you can do

Why Join Us

title: Executive Assistant with Creative Experience to the Chief of Staff: Multi-Brand Wellness House
description:
One lead, one person who takes the overflow so she can stay on the work that moves the company.



Rebel X Brands is a botanical wellness house in Austin. We build and hold DTC brands across kratom, kava, and alcohol alternatives. It moves fast in here, and the pace is the point.



Our Chief of Staff runs the operational side of the company for the CEO: executive support, finance coordination, hiring, vendors, quality control, brand work, and the systems that hold it all together. That is too many plates for one set of hands, and the overflow is what this role exists to catch. You'll be her right hand. Think of it as a smaller version of her job: the admin, the research, the calls, the design tasks, and the people coordination that pile up while she's on the high-leverage work.



You'll be trained on our tools and our way of doing things, and we expect you to grow past this job description, not sit inside it.



The work, in four tracks



Track A: Executive & Admin Support Inbox, calendar, file organization, meeting prep, follow-ups, and keeping projects from stalling. You're the person who remembers the thing everyone else forgot, and closes the loop before it's asked about.



Track B: Research, Calls & Vendor Coordination Researching suppliers, tools, providers, and options, then turning what you find into a clear one-page comparison with a recommendation. Getting on the phone: calling vendors, chasing quotes, confirming details, following up until it's actually done. You're comfortable speaking with people in the US by phone and email, and you write clearly enough that nobody has to reread you.



Track C: Design Support Canva-level graphic work: social assets, product one-pagers, decks, labels and packaging mockups, simple layouts that follow our brand guides. You don't need to be a senior designer, but you need a good eye, clean execution, and the ability to take a rough brief and come back with something usable.



Track D: People & Project Coordination Keeping track of who owes what and by when across our team, contractors, and other assistants. Chasing status, helping with onboarding, keeping trackers current, and flagging early when something is slipping. Managing people gently and clearly, without needing to be reminded.



Running through all four: AI-assisted execution. We use tools like Claude and ChatGPT to draft, research, organize, and move faster on everything above. We want someone who already works this way, not someone we have to convince.



How to apply for this

Most strong people are excellent at two or three of these tracks and average at the rest. We'd rather know that up front than find out in month two. In your proposal, tell us which tracks you're strongest in, and which ones you'd need training to grow into. Honesty here helps you, not hurts you. This is a role we train and grow, and we're hiring for trajectory as much as for today.



Who you work with

You support one person: JEM, our Chief of Staff, who owns your priorities, your approvals, and your training. Some of what you do will land in front of the CEO, but it goes through her first. One principal, one clear chain. You'll always know whose ask comes first.



What you need to have done before

Supported a busy executive or operator as an EA or VA. Made real phone calls on someone else's behalf: vendors, providers, customers, candidates. Produced design work in Canva (or similar) that other people actually used. Learned new software on your own without being walked through every step. title: Senior Server / DevOps Specialist - Linux, Docker, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
We are looking for an experienced Server Administrator / DevOps Specialist to help us review, secure, document and optimize our server infrastructure.



This is not an entry-level role. We run live production systems for active clients, so we need someone who knows how to investigate infrastructure safely without disrupting service.



We are a technology company with custom software, kiosks, digital signage and cloud-hosted web applications.



TECH ENVIRONMENT

Linux (Ubuntu/Debian), Docker/containers, Nginx/Apache, MySQL/MariaDB, Node.js, WordPress, cloud/VPS hosting (AWS, DigitalOcean and others), APIs and custom web applications.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Audit our cloud servers and identify what is running on each one

- Map how our applications, APIs and databases connect to each other

- Review resource usage, backups and snapshot schedules

- Review firewall rules, access controls and SSL/certificate management

- Review monitoring and alerting coverage

- Help harden and secure live production servers

- Identify and safely retire unused or redundant infrastructure, only after dependencies are fully verified

- Help us build fully isolated staging/development environments so our developers can test and upgrade applications without any risk to production

- Document everything clearly for management and future developers



VERY IMPORTANT

We have live clients, so caution matters more than speed. You do not delete, restart, upgrade or modify anything simply because it looks old or unused.



Our standard process for any change is: backup, dependency check, risk review, approval, execution, then testing.



We want someone comfortable tracing indirect and hidden dependencies (configuration, integrations, scheduled tasks, storage, third-party services, container networking, etc.) before touching anything.



SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Strong, current experience with Linux server administration, cloud/VPS hosting (AWS, DigitalOcean and similar), Docker, Nginx/Apache, MySQL/MariaDB, DNS, SSL, SSH, firewalls, backups/monitoring, WordPress server administration, Node.js and API-based applications, and production troubleshooting.



Bonus: Cloudflare, Nuxt.js, Portainer, and general digital-signage/kiosk device-management experience.



WHO WE WANT

Someone who thinks before touching production, can investigate an unfamiliar server methodically, documents their work, communicates clearly with non-technical management, explains risk in plain English, never guesses when evidence is missing, and can work independently. Comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to move faster, but has the technical judgment to verify anything an AI recommends before acting on it.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your years of Linux/server administration experience

2. Your experience with major cloud providers (AWS, DigitalOcean, etc.)

3. Your experience with Docker

4. An example of a production environment you inherited and had to investigate from scratch

5. An example of how you safely retired an old server without breaking anything

6. Your experience cloning production applications into staging/dev environments

7. Your hourly or project rate

8. Your availability and how soon you can start



SCREENING QUESTION

A company has an old Linux server that appears unused, but nobody is sure whether other applications still depend on it. Before deleting that server, what exactly would you check? Please answer this in your application.



Start your application with the words: SERVER AUDIT

This confirms you read the complete posting.



POSITION TYPE

Project-based / freelance to start, with potential for ongoing part-time support. Looking to start immediately.
